teach.title: Three ways to describe content, three prepositions
teach.text: يَحْتَوِي عَلَى states what is in something, غَنِيٌّ بِـ says it has a lot of it, and يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى says it is missing. Learn each with its preposition; swapping them is the commonest error in this topic.

teach.title: Non-human plurals take a feminine singular adjective
teach.text: دُهُونٌ مُشْبَعَةٌ, not مُشْبَعُونَ. Arabic treats a plural of things as grammatically feminine singular, so the adjective ends in ـَةٌ.

grammar.title: Describing nutritional content formally
grammar.overview: Three content structures, one passive of recommendation, and the agreement rule that governs every nutrient plural in the lesson.

rules.heading: يَحْتَوِي عَلَى
rules.explanation: Form VIII with a fixed preposition. The noun after it is genitive.
examples: يَحْتَوِي السَّمَكُ عَلَى بُرُوتِينٍ عَالِي الجَوْدَةِ

rules.heading: غَنِيٌّ بِـ and يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى
rules.formula: غَنِيٌّ بِـ + genitive · يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى + genitive
rules.explanation: غَنِيٌّ agrees with the noun it describes; يَفْتَقِرُ is a verb and takes إِلَى.

rules.heading: Non-human plural agreement
rules.formula: plural of things + feminine singular adjective
rules.explanation: دُهُون، أَلْيَاف، مَعَادِن and سُعْرَات all take a feminine singular adjective.

rules.heading: The impersonal recommendation
rules.explanation: A passive that gives advice without naming who gives it — standard in health writing.

quiz.feedback: يَحْتَوِي is fixed with عَلَى.

quiz.prompt: Complete: التَّمْرُ غَنِيٌّ ___ الحَدِيدِ.

quiz.feedback: يَفْتَقِرُ is fixed with إِلَى.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate agreement.
quiz.feedback: A plural of things takes a feminine singular adjective.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate impersonal recommendation.
quiz.feedback: The passive يُوصَى takes بِـ with a genitive verbal noun.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُقَلِّلُ النَّشَاطُ البَدَنِيُّ ___ خَطَرِ الأَمْرَاضِ.
quiz.feedback: يُقَلِّلُ is fixed with مِنْ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate description of a processed food.
options: أَطْعِمَةٌ مُعَالَجَةٌ تَحْتَوِي عَلَى دُهُونٍ مُشْبَعَةٍ.
أَطْعِمَةٌ مُعَالَجُونَ يَحْتَوُونَ عَلَى دُهُونٍ مُشْبَعِينَ.
quiz.feedback: Both plurals take feminine singular adjectives, and يَحْتَوِي takes عَلَى.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence is written in academic register?
options: يُوصَى بِنِظَامٍ غِذَائِيٍّ مُتَوَازِنٍ يَحْتَوِي عَلَى أَلْيَافٍ وَمَعَادِنَ.
quiz.feedback: The academic version uses the impersonal passive and precise nutrient vocabulary.

grammar.common_error: Swapping the three content prepositions, or making a nutrient plural agree as if it were human. دُهُونٌ مُشْبَعَةٌ, never مُشْبَعُونَ.
grammar.challenge: Write one sentence using all three content structures about the same food, keeping every preposition and ending accurate.

listening.title: Listening: a nutritionist explains a balanced plate
listening.script: النِّظَامُ الغِذَائِيُّ المُتَوَازِنُ يَحْتَوِي عَلَى بُرُوتِينٍ وَكَرْبُوهِيدْرَاتٍ وَدُهُونٍ غَيْرِ مُشْبَعَةٍ. الخُضَرُ وَالفَوَاكِهُ غَنِيَّةٌ بِالفِيتَامِينَاتِ وَالمَعَادِنِ، وَتَحْتَوِي عَلَى أَلْيَافٍ تُسَاعِدُ الهَضْمَ. أَمَّا الأَطْعِمَةُ المُعَالَجَةُ فَتَحْتَوِي عَادَةً عَلَى دُهُونٍ مُشْبَعَةٍ وَمِلْحٍ كَثِيرٍ، وَتَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى الأَلْيَافِ. يُوصَى بِتَنَاوُلِ خَمْسِ حِصَصٍ مِنَ الخُضَرِ وَالفَوَاكِهِ يَوْمِيًّا، وَيُنْصَحُ بِتَقْلِيلِ السُّكَّرِ. وَيُقَلِّلُ هٰذَا مِنْ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ، وَيَزِيدُ مِنَ الطَّاقَةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ.

questions.prompt: What does a balanced diet contain?
questions.feedback: يَحْتَوِي عَلَى بُرُوتِينٍ وَكَرْبُوهِيدْرَاتٍ وَدُهُونٍ غَيْرِ مُشْبَعَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What are vegetables and fruit rich in?
questions.feedback: غَنِيَّةٌ بِالفِيتَامِينَاتِ وَالمَعَادِنِ.

questions.prompt: What do processed foods lack?
questions.feedback: وَتَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى الأَلْيَافِ.

questions.prompt: How many portions are recommended daily?
questions.feedback: يُوصَى بِتَنَاوُلِ خَمْسِ حِصَصٍ … يَوْمِيًّا.

questions.prompt: What does this reduce?
questions.feedback: وَيُقَلِّلُ هٰذَا مِنْ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ.

reading.title: Reading: what makes a diet balanced
reading.text: يَعْتَمِدُ النِّظَامُ الغِذَائِيُّ المُتَوَازِنُ عَلَى التَّنَوُّعِ لَا عَلَى الحِرْمَانِ. فَالجِسْمُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى البُرُوتِينِ لِبِنَاءِ العَضَلَاتِ، وَإِلَى الكَرْبُوهِيدْرَاتِ مَصْدَرًا لِلطَّاقَةِ، وَإِلَى الدُّهُونِ غَيْرِ المُشْبَعَةِ لِوَظَائِفَ حَيَوِيَّةٍ. وَالخُضَرُ وَالفَوَاكِهُ غَنِيَّةٌ بِالفِيتَامِينَاتِ وَالمَعَادِنِ وَالأَلْيَافِ. أَمَّا الأَطْعِمَةُ المُعَالَجَةُ فَتَحْتَوِي عَلَى سُعْرَاتٍ حَرَارِيَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ وَتَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى القِيمَةِ الغِذَائِيَّةِ. وَيُوصَى بِقِرَاءَةِ المُلْصَقَاتِ قَبْلَ الشِّرَاءِ، لِأَنَّ ذٰلِكَ يُسَاعِدُ عَلَى اخْتِيَارٍ أَفْضَلَ. وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ نِظَامًا مِثَالِيًّا، بَلْ عَادَاتٌ مُسْتَدَامَةٌ يُمْكِنُ الاسْتِمْرَارُ عَلَيْهَا.

questions.prompt: What does a balanced diet depend on?
questions.feedback: يَعْتَمِدُ … عَلَى التَّنَوُّعِ لَا عَلَى الحِرْمَانِ.

questions.prompt: Why does the body need protein?
questions.feedback: يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى البُرُوتِينِ لِبِنَاءِ العَضَلَاتِ.

questions.prompt: What do processed foods lack?
questions.feedback: وَتَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى القِيمَةِ الغِذَائِيَّةِ.

questions.prompt: What is recommended before buying?
questions.feedback: وَيُوصَى بِقِرَاءَةِ المُلْصَقَاتِ قَبْلَ الشِّرَاءِ.

questions.prompt: What is the stated goal?
options: Sustainable habits rather than a perfect diet
questions.feedback: وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ نِظَامًا مِثَالِيًّا، بَلْ عَادَاتٌ مُسْتَدَامَةٌ.

prompts: صِفْ وَجْبَةً تَنَاوَلْتَهَا. عَلَى مَاذَا تَحْتَوِي؟
بِمَاذَا هِيَ غَنِيَّةٌ؟ وَإِلَى مَاذَا تَفْتَقِرُ؟

model: صِفْ وَجْبَةً تَنَاوَلْتَهَا. عَلَى مَاذَا تَحْتَوِي؟
تَحْتَوِي عَلَى بُرُوتِينٍ وَكَرْبُوهِيدْرَاتٍ، وَهِيَ غَنِيَّةٌ بِالأَلْيَافِ.
تَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى الخُضَرِ، وَلِذٰلِكَ يُوصَى بِإِضَافَةِ سَلَطَةٍ لِتَحْسِينِ التَّوَازُنِ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words analysing a meal in academic register. Say what it contains, what it is rich in, what it lacks, and what you would recommend, using the impersonal passive at least once.
checklist: All three content structures with their correct prepositions.
At least two nutrient plurals with feminine singular adjectives.
One impersonal recommendation with يُوصَى بِـ or يُنْصَحُ بِـ.
One statement of effect using يُقَلِّلُ مِنْ or يَزِيدُ مِنْ.
writing.model: تَنَاوَلْتُ أَمْسِ وَجْبَةً بَسِيطَةً مِنَ الأَرُزِّ وَالدَّجَاجِ وَالسَّلَطَةِ. تَحْتَوِي هٰذِهِ الوَجْبَةُ عَلَى بُرُوتِينٍ عَالِي الجَوْدَةِ وَكَرْبُوهِيدْرَاتٍ مُعَقَّدَةٍ، وَهِيَ غَنِيَّةٌ بِالأَلْيَافِ وَبَعْضِ المَعَادِنِ. وَلٰكِنَّهَا تَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى الفَوَاكِهِ، وَتَحْتَوِي عَلَى مِلْحٍ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا يَنْبَغِي. يُوصَى بِإِضَافَةِ حِصَّةٍ مِنَ الفَاكِهَةِ وَبِتَقْلِيلِ المِلْحِ، لِأَنَّ ذٰلِكَ يُقَلِّلُ مِنْ خَطَرِ ارْتِفَاعِ ضَغْطِ الدَّمِ وَيَزِيدُ مِنَ القِيمَةِ الغِذَائِيَّةِ. وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ الكَمَالَ، بَلْ عَادَةٌ مُسْتَدَامَةٌ.

success: I give يُقَوِّي and يُحَسِّنُ a direct object with no preposition.
I follow يُقَلِّلُ and يَزِيدُ with مِنْ.

teach.title: Two families of benefit verb
teach.text: يُقَوِّي and يُحَسِّنُ take a direct object: يُقَوِّي العَضَلَاتِ. يُقَلِّلُ، يَزِيدُ and يُخَفِّفُ take مِنْ: يُقَلِّلُ مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ. Sorting them into these two groups is the whole grammar of this lesson.

teach.title: يَزِيدُ is Form I, not Form II
teach.text: زَادَ / يَزِيدُ is a hollow Form I verb, so its past with a suffix is زِدْتُ. It looks like the Form II verbs around it but behaves differently.

grammar.title: Benefit verbs and their complements
grammar.overview: One decision governs every sentence in this lesson: does the verb take a direct object, or does it take مِنْ?

rules.heading: Direct-object benefit verbs
rules.explanation: Form II verbs of this group take a direct object with no preposition.

rules.heading: Benefit verbs with مِنْ
rules.explanation: These describe raising or lowering a quantity, and the thing measured follows مِنْ.
examples: يُقَلِّلُ المَشْيُ مِنْ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ

rules.heading: يُسَاعِدُ عَلَى
rules.explanation: Form III with a fixed preposition, followed by a verbal noun.

rules.heading: Past habit against present habit
rules.formula: كَانَ + present vs a present verb
rules.explanation: كُنْتُ أَتَمَرَّنُ describes what you used to do; أَتَمَرَّنُ describes what you do now.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence.
quiz.feedback: يُقَوِّي takes a direct object with no preposition.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُقَلِّلُ المَشْيُ ___ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ.
quiz.feedback: يُقَلِّلُ is fixed with مِنْ.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَزِيدُ التَّمْرِينُ ___ قُدْرَةِ التَّحَمُّلِ.
quiz.feedback: يَزِيدُ takes مِنْ in this sense.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with يُحَسِّنُ.
quiz.feedback: يُحَسِّنُ takes a direct object.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُسَاعِدُ الإِحْمَاءُ ___ تَجَنُّبِ الإِصَابَةِ.
quiz.feedback: يُسَاعِدُ is fixed with عَلَى.

quiz.prompt: Which is the past of يَزِيدُ with the أَنَا suffix?
quiz.feedback: زَادَ is hollow, so the stem shortens to زِدْـ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate contrast of past and present habit.
options: كُنْتُ أَتَمَرَّنُ مَرَّةً فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، أَمَّا الآنَ فَأَتَمَرَّنُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.
كُنْتُ تَمَرَّنْتُ مَرَّةً، أَمَّا الآنَ فَتَمَرَّنْتُ ثَلَاثًا.
أَتَمَرَّنُ مَرَّةً فِي المَاضِي وَكُنْتُ أَتَمَرَّنُ الآنَ.
quiz.feedback: كَانَ plus a present verb for the old habit; a plain present for the current one.

reading.title: Reading: moderate activity, real benefits
reading.text: لَا يَحْتَاجُ الإِنْسَانُ إِلَى تَدْرِيبٍ قَاسٍ لِيَسْتَفِيدَ مِنَ الحَرَكَةِ. فَالنَّشَاطُ المُعْتَدِلُ المُنْتَظِمُ يُقَوِّي القَلْبَ وَالعَضَلَاتِ، وَيُحَسِّنُ النَّوْمَ وَالحَالَةَ المِزَاجِيَّةَ. وَتُشِيرُ دِرَاسَاتٌ كَثِيرَةٌ إِلَى أَنَّ المَشْيَ السَّرِيعَ يُقَلِّلُ مِنْ خَطَرِ عِدَّةِ أَمْرَاضٍ مُزْمِنَةٍ. أَمَّا تَمَارِينُ المُقَاوَمَةِ فَتَزِيدُ مِنَ القُوَّةِ العَضَلِيَّةِ وَتَحْمِي العِظَامَ. وَيُوصَى بِمِئَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ دَقِيقَةً مِنَ النَّشَاطِ المُعْتَدِلِ أُسْبُوعِيًّا، مُوَزَّعَةً عَلَى أَيَّامٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ. وَلَيْسَ المُهِمُّ شِدَّةَ التَّمْرِينِ بِقَدْرِ مَا هُوَ الاسْتِمْرَارُ عَلَيْهِ.

lessons.title: Mental Health and Wellbeing — Talking About Stress and Happiness
lessons.arabic: الصِّحَّةُ النَّفْسِيَّةُ وَالعَافِيَةُ — الحَدِيثُ عَنِ التَّوَتُّرِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ
lessons.summary: The P1 grammar milestone: build Type 1 conditional sentences with إِذَا and سَـ, and use them to talk about stress, coping and wellbeing.
objectives: Build a Type 1 conditional: إِذَا + past-form verb → سَـ with a present verb.
Recognise a Type 2 conditional with لَوْ and understand what it means.
Describe stress and coping with يُعَانِي مِنْ، يَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ and يَتَغَلَّبُ عَلَى.
Write about wellbeing without diagnosing or advising beyond your knowledge.
success: I use a past-form verb after إِذَا even though the meaning is present or future.
I mark the result clause with سَـ or سَوْفَ.
I follow each coping verb with its own preposition.
I write about mental health carefully, describing rather than prescribing.

items.note: Masculine; a clinical term, used carefully.
Form III, root ع-ن-ي; fixed with مِنْ.
Not a conditional; states a time.

teach.title: إِذَا takes a past-form verb, but the meaning is not past
teach.text: إِذَا تَمَرَّنْتَ يَوْمِيًّا، سَتَشْعُرُ بِتَحَسُّنٍ means “if you exercise daily, you will feel better”. The verb after إِذَا looks past but refers to a real future condition. This is the single most important form in P1.

teach.title: Write about mental health carefully
teach.text: Describe what people experience and what generally helps. Avoid diagnosing, and avoid promising outcomes. اكْتِئَاب is a clinical word — use it precisely, and prefer يُنْصَحُ بِطَلَبِ المُسَاعَدَةِ to telling someone what they must feel.

grammar.title: Type 1 conditionals and coping verbs
grammar.overview: One new structure with two halves, plus four coping verbs each with a fixed preposition. Get the verb form after إِذَا right and the rest follows.

rules.heading: The Type 1 conditional
rules.formula: إِذَا + past-form verb → سَـ + present verb
rules.explanation: The condition clause uses a past-form verb regardless of the time meant; the result clause is marked with سَـ or سَوْفَ.
examples: إِذَا نِمْتَ مُبَكِّرًا، سَتَكُونُ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا

rules.heading: The order can reverse
rules.explanation: Putting the condition second is equally correct; only the comma placement changes.

rules.heading: لَوْ signals a hypothetical
rules.explanation: لَوْ describes something contrary to fact. Recognise it now; you will produce it later.
examples: لَوْ نِمْتَ جَيِّدًا، لَكُنْتَ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا

rules.heading: Coping verbs and their prepositions
rules.formula: يُعَانِي مِنْ · يَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ · يَتَغَلَّبُ عَلَى · يَسْعَى إِلَى
rules.explanation: Each preposition is fixed and takes the genitive.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate Type 1 conditional.

patterns.tip: لَوْ marks a hypothetical, answered by لَـ.

mistakes.wrong: كُلُّ مَنْ يَشْعُرُ بِالحُزْنِ مُصَابٌ بِالاكْتِئَابِ.
mistakes.right: قَدْ يَشْعُرُ الإِنْسَانُ بِالحُزْنِ دُونَ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُصَابًا بِالاكْتِئَابِ.
mistakes.why: Sadness is not the same as a clinical diagnosis, so equating them overstates.

listening.title: Listening: a student talks about pressure
listening.script: يُعَانِي كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ قَبْلَ الامْتِحَانَاتِ، وَهٰذَا أَمْرٌ طَبِيعِيٌّ. وَأَنَا أَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ الضَّغْطِ بِتَنْظِيمِ وَقْتِي وَبِالمَشْيِ كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ. إِذَا نَظَّمْتَ وَقْتَكَ جَيِّدًا، سَتَشْعُرُ بِسَيْطَرَةٍ أَكْبَرَ. وَإِذَا نِمْتَ سَبْعَ سَاعَاتٍ، سَتَكُونُ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا فِي اليَوْمِ التَّالِي. أَمَّا إِذَا أَهْمَلْتَ الرَّاحَةَ، فَسَيَزْدَادُ الإِرْهَاقُ. وَلَيْسَ كُلُّ حُزْنٍ اكْتِئَابًا؛ فَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّتِ الأَعْرَاضُ، يُنْصَحُ بِطَلَبِ المُسَاعَدَةِ مِنْ مُخْتَصٍّ. وَأَسْعَى إِلَى تَوَازُنٍ بَيْنَ الدِّرَاسَةِ وَالرَّاحَةِ.

questions.prompt: What is described as normal?
questions.feedback: يُعَانِي كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ … وَهٰذَا أَمْرٌ طَبِيعِيٌّ.

options: Organising time and walking each evening

reading.title: Reading: small habits, real difference
reading.text: تُشِيرُ دِرَاسَاتٌ كَثِيرَةٌ إِلَى أَنَّ عَادَاتٍ صَغِيرَةً تُخَفِّفُ مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ اليَوْمِيِّ. فَإِذَا نَظَّمْتَ وَقْتَكَ، سَتَقِلُّ مُفَاجَآتُ اليَوْمِ. وَإِذَا خَرَجْتَ لِلْمَشْيِ عِشْرِينَ دَقِيقَةً، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ حَالَتُكَ المِزَاجِيَّةُ. وَإِذَا تَحَدَّثْتَ إِلَى صَدِيقٍ تَثِقُ بِهِ، سَتَشْعُرُ بِأَنَّ العِبْءَ أَخَفُّ. وَيَتَعَامَلُ النَّاسُ مَعَ الضَّغْطِ بِطُرُقٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ؛ فَمَا يُنَاسِبُ شَخْصًا قَدْ لَا يُنَاسِبُ آخَرَ. وَلَيْسَتْ هٰذِهِ العَادَاتُ بَدِيلًا عَنِ العِلَاجِ عِنْدَ الحَاجَةِ، بَلْ دَعْمٌ إِضَافِيٌّ. وَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ القَلَقُ وَأَثَّرَ فِي الدِّرَاسَةِ وَالنَّوْمِ، فَيُنْصَحُ بِاسْتِشَارَةِ مُخْتَصٍّ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words about managing pressure. Use at least three Type 1 conditionals, two coping verbs with their prepositions, and one careful statement about when to seek help.
checklist: Three Type 1 conditionals, each with a past-form verb after إِذَا.
Each result clause marked with سَـ or سَوْفَ.
Two coping verbs with their fixed prepositions.
One statement that advises rather than diagnoses.
writing.model: يُعَانِي كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ قَبْلَ الامْتِحَانَاتِ، وَهٰذَا أَمْرٌ طَبِيعِيٌّ. إِذَا نَظَّمْتَ وَقْتَكَ مُبَكِّرًا، سَتَقِلُّ المُفَاجَآتُ وَسَتَشْعُرُ بِسَيْطَرَةٍ أَكْبَرَ. وَإِذَا خَرَجْتَ لِلْمَشْيِ عِشْرِينَ دَقِيقَةً يَوْمِيًّا، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ حَالَتُكَ المِزَاجِيَّةُ. وَإِذَا نِمْتَ سَبْعَ سَاعَاتٍ، سَتَكُونُ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا. أَنَا أَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ الضَّغْطِ بِالرِّيَاضَةِ وَالحَدِيثِ إِلَى صَدِيقٍ أَثِقُ بِهِ، وَأَسْعَى إِلَى تَوَازُنٍ بَيْنَ الدِّرَاسَةِ وَالرَّاحَةِ. وَلَيْسَ كُلُّ حُزْنٍ اكْتِئَابًا؛ فَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّتِ الأَعْرَاضُ وَأَثَّرَتْ فِي الحَيَاةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ، فَيُنْصَحُ بِاسْتِشَارَةِ مُخْتَصٍّ.

mission.title: Conditional Mission — إِذَا and the Result Clause
mission.intro: Every round checks the verb form after إِذَا, the marker in the result, or the preposition on a coping verb.

rounds.prompt: Form: complete — إِذَا ___ مُبَكِّرًا، سَتَكُونُ أَكْثَرَ نَشَاطًا.
rounds.feedback: إِذَا takes a past-form verb; نَامَ is hollow, giving نِمْتَ.

rounds.prompt: Marker: which belongs in the result clause?
rounds.feedback: The result of a Type 1 conditional is marked with سَـ or سَوْفَ.

options: لَوْ نِمْتَ جَيِّدًا، لَكُنْتَ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا.
إِذَا نِمْتَ جَيِّدًا، سَتَكُونُ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا.
rounds.feedback: لَوْ marks something contrary to fact.

rounds.prompt: Order: which reversed conditional is accurate?
rounds.feedback: The order can reverse, but إِذَا still takes the past form.
It distinguishes an ordinary feeling from a clinical condition.
بِشَرْطِ أَنْ states a condition and takes the subjunctive.

rounds.prompt: Which is a time clause rather than a condition?
rounds.feedback: عِنْدَمَا states when something happens, not a condition.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which answer is the most complete?
options: إِذَا نَظَّمْتَ وَقْتَكَ، سَتَشْعُرُ بِسَيْطَرَةٍ أَكْبَرَ، وَأَنَا أَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ الضَّغْطِ بِالمَشْيِ.
إِذَا تُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَكَ، تَشْعُرُ بِسَيْطَرَةٍ، وَأَتَعَامَلُ مِنَ الضَّغْطِ.
rounds.feedback: Past form after إِذَا, سَـ in the result, and مَعَ after يَتَعَامَلُ.

groups: وَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ القَلَقُ فَيُنْصَحُ بِاسْتِشَارَةِ مُخْتَصٍّ

live_builder.feedback: Each condition, result and coping detail is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.feedback: The verb after إِذَا takes the past form even when the meaning is future.

builder_tasks.title: Mark the result clause

builder_tasks.feedback: Sadness and a clinical diagnosis are not the same thing.

lessons.title: Unhealthy Habits — Smoking, Alcohol and Risk Behaviours
lessons.arabic: العَادَاتُ غَيْرُ الصِّحِّيَّةِ — التَّدْخِينُ وَالكُحُولُ وَالسُّلُوكِيَّاتُ الخَطِرَةُ
lessons.summary: Describe risk behaviours and their documented effects in informational register, using Type 1 conditionals and the passive يُوصَفُ بِأَنَّهُ.
objectives: Name risk behaviours and their documented health effects accurately.
Use Type 1 conditionals to express consequence rather than to lecture.
Use يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِـ and يُضْعِفُ with their correct complements.
Write a balanced risk paragraph that informs without moralising.
success: I follow يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ with بِـ and give يُضْعِفُ a direct object.
I use إِذَا with a past-form verb and mark the result with سَـ.
I report evidence with يُوصَفُ بِأَنَّهُ rather than asserting personally.
I describe giving up as difficult rather than as a simple choice.

items.note: Describe the condition, not the person's worth.
Form IV; takes a direct object.
Form IV; the harmed thing follows بِـ.
A passive; أَنَّ takes an accusative pronoun.

teach.title: Two harm verbs, two structures
teach.text: يُضْعِفُ takes a direct object: يُضْعِفُ جِهَازَ المَنَاعَةِ. يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ takes بِـ for what is harmed: يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِالرِّئَتَيْنِ. The noun الضَّرَرَ is already the object of يُلْحِقُ.

teach.title: Inform, do not lecture
teach.text: Report what the evidence shows with تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ or يُوصَفُ بِأَنَّهُ, and acknowledge that giving up is hard. A paragraph that informs is worth more marks than one that moralises, and it is more accurate.

grammar.title: Harm verbs, conditionals and reported evidence
grammar.overview: Two harm verbs with different complements, the Type 1 conditional applied to consequence, and the passive used to report evidence impersonally.

rules.heading: يُضْعِفُ with a direct object
rules.explanation: Form IV with a direct object and no preposition.

rules.heading: يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِـ
rules.explanation: الضَّرَرَ is the object of the verb; بِـ introduces what is harmed.

rules.heading: Conditional consequence
rules.explanation: State the consequence as a conditional rather than as a command.
examples: إِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ فِي التَّدْخِينِ، سَيَزْدَادُ خَطَرُ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ

rules.heading: Reporting evidence impersonally
rules.formula: يُوصَفُ بِأَنَّهُ · تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ
rules.explanation: These report findings without you asserting them personally. The noun or pronoun after أَنَّ is accusative.
examples: يُوصَفُ التَّدْخِينُ بِأَنَّهُ سَبَبٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ لِأَمْرَاضِ الرِّئَةِ
تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ الإِقْلَاعَ يُحَسِّنُ الصِّحَّةَ سَرِيعًا

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence.
quiz.feedback: يُضْعِفُ takes a direct object.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُلْحِقُ التَّدْخِينُ الضَّرَرَ ___ الرِّئَتَيْنِ.
quiz.feedback: بِـ introduces what is harmed.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate conditional consequence.
options: إِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ فِي التَّدْخِينِ، سَيَزْدَادُ الخَطَرُ.
إِذَا يَسْتَمِرُّ فِي التَّدْخِينِ، يَزْدَادُ الخَطَرُ.
إِذَا سَيَسْتَمِرُّ فِي التَّدْخِينِ، ازْدَادَ الخَطَرُ.
quiz.feedback: إِذَا takes a past-form verb and the result is marked with سَـ.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُوصَفُ التَّدْخِينُ ___ سَبَبٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ لِأَمْرَاضِ الرِّئَةِ.
quiz.feedback: يُوصَفُ takes بِـ, and the masculine pronoun matches التَّدْخِين.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُقْلِعُ ___ التَّدْخِينِ بِمُسَاعَدَةِ الدَّعْمِ.
quiz.feedback: يُقْلِعُ is fixed with عَنْ.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence informs rather than moralises?
options: تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ الإِقْلَاعَ يُحَسِّنُ الصِّحَّةَ سَرِيعًا.
quiz.feedback: It reports evidence rather than judging people.

quiz.prompt: Which framing is accurate about giving up?
options: الإِقْلَاعُ لَيْسَ سَهْلًا، وَيَحْتَاجُ إِلَى دَعْمٍ.
quiz.feedback: Dependence is physical as well as habitual, so support matters.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَزِيدُ التَّدْخِينُ مِنْ ___ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ.
quiz.feedback: مِنْ is followed by a genitive noun in an iḍāfa.

grammar.common_error: Writing يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ عَلَى or adding a preposition after يُضْعِفُ. Also avoid describing people rather than behaviour — the topic is the habit and its effects.
grammar.challenge: Write one sentence reporting evidence with تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ and one conditional consequence, without judging anyone.

builders.target: Build accurate risk statements from an effect, a conditional and a supportive close.
groups: وَالإِقْلَاعُ لَيْسَ سَهْلًا وَيَحْتَاجُ إِلَى دَعْمٍ
builders.feedback: Each effect, conditional and closing statement is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

يُضْعِفُ takes a direct object.

listening.title: Listening: a public health briefing
listening.script: يُوصَفُ التَّدْخِينُ بِأَنَّهُ سَبَبٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ لِأَمْرَاضِ الرِّئَةِ وَالقَلْبِ. وَتُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّهُ يُضْعِفُ جِهَازَ المَنَاعَةِ وَيُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِالأَوْعِيَةِ الدَّمَوِيَّةِ. وَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الشَّخْصُ فِي التَّدْخِينِ سَنَوَاتٍ طَوِيلَةً، سَيَزْدَادُ خَطَرُ تَصَلُّبِ الشَّرَايِينِ. أَمَّا إِذَا أَقْلَعَ، فَسَتَتَحَسَّنُ وَظَائِفُ الرِّئَةِ خِلَالَ أَشْهُرٍ. وَالإِقْلَاعُ لَيْسَ سَهْلًا، لِأَنَّ الاعْتِمَادَ جَسَدِيٌّ وَنَفْسِيٌّ مَعًا؛ وَلِذٰلِكَ يُنْصَحُ بِطَلَبِ الدَّعْمِ الطِّبِّيِّ. وَتَخْتَلِفُ سِيَاسَاتُ الوِقَايَةِ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلَى بَلَدٍ، قَانُونِيًّا وَاجْتِمَاعِيًّا.

questions.prompt: How is smoking described?
options: A main cause of lung and heart disease
questions.feedback: يُوصَفُ التَّدْخِينُ بِأَنَّهُ سَبَبٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ لِأَمْرَاضِ الرِّئَةِ وَالقَلْبِ.

questions.prompt: What do studies indicate it weakens?
questions.feedback: يُضْعِفُ جِهَازَ المَنَاعَةِ.

questions.prompt: What follows from continuing for many years?
questions.feedback: سَيَزْدَادُ خَطَرُ تَصَلُّبِ الشَّرَايِينِ.

questions.prompt: What happens if a person gives up?
questions.feedback: فَسَتَتَحَسَّنُ وَظَائِفُ الرِّئَةِ خِلَالَ أَشْهُرٍ.

questions.prompt: Why is giving up described as not easy?
options: Dependence is both physical and psychological
questions.feedback: لِأَنَّ الاعْتِمَادَ جَسَدِيٌّ وَنَفْسِيٌّ مَعًا.

reading.title: Reading: risk, evidence and support
reading.text: تَتَنَاوَلُ سِيَاسَاتُ الصِّحَّةِ العَامَّةِ السُّلُوكِيَّاتِ الخَطِرَةَ بِوَصْفِهَا مَسْأَلَةً صِحِّيَّةً لَا أَخْلَاقِيَّةً فَقَطْ. فَالتَّدْخِينُ يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِالرِّئَتَيْنِ وَالقَلْبِ، وَيَزِيدُ مِنْ خُطُورَةِ عِدَّةِ أَنْوَاعٍ مِنَ السَّرَطَانِ. وَيُوصَفُ الإِفْرَاطُ فِي الكُحُولِ بِأَنَّهُ عَامِلُ خَطَرٍ لِأَمْرَاضِ الكَبِدِ. وَتُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ الدَّعْمَ الطِّبِّيَّ وَالاجْتِمَاعِيَّ يَرْفَعُ فُرَصَ الإِقْلَاعِ بِوُضُوحٍ. وَإِذَا تَوَفَّرَ الدَّعْمُ المُبَكِّرُ، سَتَقِلُّ حَالَاتُ الإِدْمَانِ طَوِيلِ المَدَى. وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ لَوْمَ الأَفْرَادِ، بَلْ تَقْلِيلُ الضَّرَرِ وَتَوْفِيرُ الوِقَايَةِ. وَتَخْتَلِفُ التَّشْرِيعَاتُ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلَى بَلَدٍ.

questions.prompt: How do public health policies treat risk behaviours?

questions.prompt: What is stated as the goal?
options: Reducing harm and providing prevention, not blaming individuals
questions.feedback: وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ لَوْمَ الأَفْرَادِ، بَلْ تَقْلِيلُ الضَّرَرِ وَتَوْفِيرُ الوِقَايَةِ.

prompts: مَا أَثَرُ التَّدْخِينِ عَلَى الصِّحَّةِ؟ اِسْتَعْمِلْ يُضْعِفُ أَوْ يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِـ.
مَاذَا سَيَحْدُثُ إِذَا أَقْلَعَ الشَّخْصُ؟
لِمَاذَا يُقَالُ إِنَّ الإِقْلَاعَ لَيْسَ سَهْلًا؟
model: يُضْعِفُ جِهَازَ المَنَاعَةِ وَيُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِالرِّئَتَيْنِ وَالقَلْبِ.
إِذَا أَقْلَعَ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ وَظَائِفُ الرِّئَةِ خِلَالَ أَشْهُرٍ، وَلٰكِنَّ الإِقْلَاعَ لَيْسَ سَهْلًا وَيَحْتَاجُ إِلَى دَعْمٍ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words on a risk behaviour and its health effects. Report evidence impersonally, use at least two conditionals, and close by acknowledging that giving up needs support — without moralising.
checklist: One sentence with يُضْعِفُ and one with يُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِـ.

A closing that describes the behaviour, not the worth of people.
writing.model: يُوصَفُ التَّدْخِينُ بِأَنَّهُ سَبَبٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ لِأَمْرَاضِ الرِّئَةِ وَالقَلْبِ. وَتُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّهُ يُضْعِفُ جِهَازَ المَنَاعَةِ وَيُلْحِقُ الضَّرَرَ بِالأَوْعِيَةِ الدَّمَوِيَّةِ، وَيَزِيدُ مِنْ خُطُورَةِ عِدَّةِ أَمْرَاضٍ. وَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الشَّخْصُ سَنَوَاتٍ طَوِيلَةً، سَيَزْدَادُ خَطَرُ تَصَلُّبِ الشَّرَايِينِ. أَمَّا إِذَا أَقْلَعَ، فَسَتَتَحَسَّنُ وَظَائِفُ الرِّئَةِ خِلَالَ أَشْهُرٍ. وَالإِقْلَاعُ لَيْسَ سَهْلًا، لِأَنَّ الاعْتِمَادَ جَسَدِيٌّ وَنَفْسِيٌّ مَعًا، وَلِذٰلِكَ يُنْصَحُ بِالدَّعْمِ الطِّبِّيِّ. وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ لَوْمَ الأَفْرَادِ، بَلْ تَقْلِيلُ الضَّرَرِ.

differentiation.stretch: Close with a balanced statement on support and prevention that avoids moralising.

final.feedback: بِـ marks what receives the harm.
يُضْعِفُ takes a direct object.

final.prompt: Complete: إِذَا ___ عَنِ التَّدْخِينِ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ صِحَّتُهُ.
final.feedback: إِذَا takes a past-form verb.

options: تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ الدَّعْمَ يَرْفَعُ فُرَصَ الإِقْلَاعِ.
final.feedback: It reports evidence about what helps.

lessons.title: Sleep, Rest and Digital Wellbeing
lessons.summary: Link screen use to sleep quality, use conditional sentences to state sleep-health relationships, and plan digital wellbeing.
objectives: Describe sleep quality and the sleep cycle with precise vocabulary.
Use Type 1 conditionals to link screen use and sleep.
Use يُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى and يُعِيقُ with their correct complements.
Write a digital wellbeing plan connecting screens to rest.
success: I follow يُؤَثِّرُ with عَلَى and give يُعِيقُ a direct object.
I use a past-form verb after إِذَا and mark the result with سَـ.
I describe screen habits without moralising about technology.
I connect a cause to an effect rather than listing facts.

teach.title: يُؤَثِّرُ takes عَلَى; يُعِيقُ takes an object
teach.text: يُؤَثِّرُ الضَّوْءُ الأَزْرَقُ عَلَى النَّوْمِ, but يُعِيقُ الضَّوْءُ الأَزْرَقُ النَّوْمَ. One is fixed with عَلَى, the other takes a direct object with no preposition.

teach.title: Connect cause to effect, do not just list
teach.text: A strong sentence links a habit to its result: إِذَا اسْتَعْمَلْتَ الهَاتِفَ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، سَتَقِلُّ جَوْدَةُ نَوْمِكَ. That is worth more than naming screen time and sleep as two separate facts.

grammar.title: Conditionals and cause-effect for sleep
grammar.overview: Type 1 conditionals from L03 applied to a new topic, plus the cause-effect verbs and their fixed complements.

rules.heading: Conditional link
rules.explanation: State the sleep-health relationship as a real condition.
examples: إِذَا نِمْتَ سَبْعَ سَاعَاتٍ، سَتَشْعُرُ بِنَشَاطٍ

rules.heading: يُعِيقُ with an object
rules.explanation: Form IV, hollow, taking a direct object.

rules.heading: Linking verbs
rules.explanation: Each links a cause to an effect with its own preposition.

listening.title: Listening: screens, light and sleep
listening.script: يُؤَثِّرُ الضَّوْءُ الأَزْرَقُ مِنَ الشَّاشَاتِ عَلَى دَوْرَةِ النَّوْمِ، وَتُعِيقُ الإِشْعَارَاتُ النَّوْمَ العَمِيقَ. إِذَا اسْتَعْمَلْتَ الهَاتِفَ فِي السَّرِيرِ، سَتَقِلُّ جَوْدَةُ نَوْمِكَ. وَإِذَا خَصَّصْتَ فَتْرَةَ هُدُوءٍ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ بِلَا شَاشَاتٍ، سَتَنَامُ أَعْمَقَ. يَرْتَبِطُ الأَرَقُ بِالتَّعَبِ المُزْمِنِ وَضَعْفِ التَّرْكِيزِ. وَلَيْسَتِ التِّقْنِيَّةُ عَدُوًّا؛ فَالمُهِمُّ هُوَ التَّوَازُنُ. يُنْصَحُ بِإِطْفَاءِ الإِشْعَارَاتِ لَيْلًا وَبِتَنْظِيمِ سَاعَاتِ النَّوْمِ. نَتِيجَةً لِذٰلِكَ يَتَحَسَّنُ المِزَاجُ وَالتَّرْكِيزُ فِي اليَوْمِ التَّالِي.

reading.title: Reading: rest is not a luxury
reading.text: لَا يَقِلُّ النَّوْمُ أَهَمِّيَّةً عَنِ الغِذَاءِ وَالحَرَكَةِ. فَخِلَالَ النَّوْمِ العَمِيقِ يُعِيدُ الجِسْمُ بِنَاءَ خَلَايَاهُ وَيُنَظِّمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ. وَتُشِيرُ دِرَاسَاتٌ إِلَى أَنَّ اسْتِعْمَالَ الشَّاشَاتِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ يُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى جَوْدَةِ النَّوْمِ، لِأَنَّ الضَّوْءَ الأَزْرَقَ يُؤَخِّرُ إِفْرَازَ هُرْمُونِ النَّوْمِ. وَإِذَا نَامَ المُرَاهِقُ أَقَلَّ مِنْ سَبْعِ سَاعَاتٍ بِانْتِظَامٍ، فَقَدْ يَزْدَادُ التَّوَتُّرُ وَيَضْعُفُ التَّرْكِيزُ. وَلَيْسَ الحَلُّ مَنْعَ التِّقْنِيَّةِ، بَلْ تَنْظِيمَ اسْتِعْمَالِهَا. يُوصَى بِفَتْرَةِ هُدُوءٍ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ وَبِبِيئَةٍ مُظْلِمَةٍ وَهَادِئَةٍ. وَمَا يُنَاسِبُ شَخْصًا قَدْ يَخْتَلِفُ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ.

questions.prompt: How important is sleep, per the text?
options: No less important than food and movement
questions.feedback: لَا يَقِلُّ النَّوْمُ أَهَمِّيَّةً عَنِ الغِذَاءِ وَالحَرَكَةِ.

questions.prompt: What happens during deep sleep?
options: The body rebuilds cells and organises memory
questions.feedback: يُعِيدُ الجِسْمُ بِنَاءَ خَلَايَاهُ وَيُنَظِّمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ.

questions.prompt: Why do screens affect sleep quality?
options: Blue light delays the sleep hormone
questions.feedback: لِأَنَّ الضَّوْءَ الأَزْرَقَ يُؤَخِّرُ إِفْرَازَ هُرْمُونِ النَّوْمِ.

questions.prompt: What is the stated solution?
options: Regulating technology use, not banning it
questions.feedback: وَلَيْسَ الحَلُّ مَنْعَ التِّقْنِيَّةِ، بَلْ تَنْظِيمَ اسْتِعْمَالِهَا.

questions.prompt: What does the text say about what suits people?
options: It may differ from one person to another
questions.feedback: وَمَا يُنَاسِبُ شَخْصًا قَدْ يَخْتَلِفُ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ.

speaking.context: Speaking: your screens and your sleep
prompts: كَيْفَ يُؤَثِّرُ اسْتِعْمَالُ الشَّاشَةِ عَلَى نَوْمِكَ؟
مَاذَا سَيَحْدُثُ إِذَا خَصَّصْتَ فَتْرَةَ هُدُوءٍ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ؟
كَيْفَ تُنَظِّمُ تَوَازُنَكَ الرَّقْمِيَّ؟
model: كَيْفَ يُؤَثِّرُ اسْتِعْمَالُ الشَّاشَةِ عَلَى نَوْمِكَ؟
إِذَا اسْتَعْمَلْتُ الهَاتِفَ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، تَقِلُّ جَوْدَةُ نَوْمِي وَأَشْعُرُ بِالتَّعَبِ.
أُطْفِئُ الإِشْعَارَاتِ لَيْلًا وَأَحُدُّ مِنْ وَقْتِ الشَّاشَةِ، وَنَتِيجَةً لِذٰلِكَ يَتَحَسَّنُ تَرْكِيزِي.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words on a digital wellbeing plan. Link screen habits to sleep with at least two conditionals, use يُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى and يُعِيقُ, and close with a balanced view of technology.
checklist: Two Type 1 conditionals linking screens and sleep.
One sentence with يُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى and one with يُعِيقُ.
One cause-effect link with يُؤَدِّي إِلَى or يَرْتَبِطُ بِـ.
A balanced closing that regulates rather than bans technology.
writing.model: يُؤَثِّرُ اسْتِعْمَالُ الشَّاشَاتِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ عَلَى جَوْدَةِ نَوْمِي، وَتُعِيقُ الإِشْعَارَاتُ نَوْمِي العَمِيقَ. إِذَا اسْتَعْمَلْتُ الهَاتِفَ فِي السَّرِيرِ، سَتَقِلُّ سَاعَاتُ نَوْمِي وَسَأَشْعُرُ بِالتَّعَبِ فِي اليَوْمِ التَّالِي. وَإِذَا خَصَّصْتُ فَتْرَةَ هُدُوءٍ بِلَا شَاشَاتٍ، سَأَنَامُ أَعْمَقَ. يَرْتَبِطُ الأَرَقُ بِالتَّعَبِ المُزْمِنِ، وَلِذٰلِكَ أَحُدُّ مِنَ الإِشْعَارَاتِ اللَّيْلِيَّةِ وَأُنَظِّمُ سَاعَاتِ نَوْمِي. وَلَيْسَتِ التِّقْنِيَّةُ عَدُوًّا؛ فَالمُهِمُّ هُوَ التَّوَازُنُ الرَّقْمِيُّ، لِأَنَّ الرَّاحَةَ الجَيِّدَةَ تُحَسِّنُ المِزَاجَ وَالتَّرْكِيزَ.

differentiation.core: Write five cause-effect sentences using the verbs with their complements.
differentiation.develop: Add two conditionals linking screens and sleep.
differentiation.stretch: Close with a balanced view and one impersonal recommendation.

final.feedback: يُؤَثِّرُ is fixed with عَلَى.

final.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with يُعِيقُ.
final.feedback: يُعِيقُ takes a direct object.

final.prompt: Complete: إِذَا ___ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، سَتَنَامُ أَفْضَلَ.
final.feedback: إِذَا takes a past-form verb.

options: إِذَا قَلَّلْتُ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ جَوْدَةُ نَوْمِي، وَلٰكِنَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ لَيْسَتْ عَدُوًّا.
إِذَا أُقَلِّلُ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، تَحَسَّنَتْ جَوْدَةُ نَوْمِي.
final.feedback: Correct conditional, correct complement and a balanced close.

mission.title: Sleep Mission — Complements, Conditionals and Balance
mission.intro: Check the complement, the conditional form, and whether technology is treated with balance.

rounds.prompt: Marker: which belongs in the result clause?
rounds.feedback: The result of a Type 1 conditional is marked with سَـ.
It treats technology as needing balance, not banning.

rounds.prompt: Cause: which sentence links a cause to an effect?
rounds.feedback: يُؤَدِّي إِلَى connects cause and result.
بِيئَة is feminine and nominative here.
The order may reverse; إِذَا still takes the past form.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which answer is the most complete?
options: إِذَا قَلَّلْتَ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ جَوْدَةُ نَوْمِكَ، وَيَرْتَبِطُ الأَرَقُ بِالتَّعَبِ.
إِذَا تُقَلِّلُ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، تَتَحَسَّنُ، وَالأَرَقُ يَرْتَبِطُ عَلَى التَّعَبِ.
الشَّاشَةُ تُعِيقُ عَلَى النَّوْمِ وَإِذَا سَتُقَلِّلُ تَنَامُ.
rounds.feedback: Correct conditional, correct complements and a cause-effect link.

live_builder.target: Build sleep-health statements from a conditional, a result and a link.
live_builder.feedback: Each condition, result and link is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the sentence so يُؤَثِّرُ has its fixed preposition.
builder_tasks.feedback: يُؤَثِّرُ is fixed with عَلَى.

builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the sentence so يُعِيقُ takes a direct object.
builder_tasks.feedback: يُعِيقُ takes a direct object.

builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the condition clause.

options: إِذَا قَلَّلْتَ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، سَتَنَامُ أَفْضَلَ.
إِذَا سَتُقَلِّلُ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، سَتَنَامُ أَفْضَلَ.
إِذَا قَلَّلْتَ وَقْتَ الشَّاشَةِ، تَنَامُ أَمْسِ أَفْضَلَ.
builder_tasks.feedback: The verb after إِذَا takes the past form.

lessons.title: Healthcare Systems — Hospitals, Doctors and Treatment
lessons.arabic: أَنْظِمَةُ الرِّعَايَةِ الصِّحِّيَّةِ — المُسْتَشْفَيَاتُ وَالأَطِبَّاءُ وَالعِلَاجُ
lessons.summary: Describe healthcare with the medical passive يُشَخَّصُ، يُعَالَجُ، يُوصَفُ, and narrate a healthcare experience across past, present and conditional.
objectives: Name parts of a healthcare system and stages of treatment.
Use the medical passive: يُشَخَّصُ، يُعَالَجُ، يُوصَفُ، يُحَالُ.
Use يُشَخِّصُ، يُعَالِجُ، يَصِفُ، يُحِيلُ إِلَى in the active voice with correct complements.
Narrate a healthcare experience using past, present and conditional.
success: I form the passive by changing the vowels, keeping the affected noun nominative.
I follow يُحِيلُ with إِلَى and give يُعَالِجُ a direct object.
I use يَصِفُ الدَّوَاءَ, not the non-standard يُوصِفُ.
I move between tenses cleanly in a short narrative.

items.note: Form IV, hollow; fixed with إِلَى.

teach.title: The medical passive names the procedure, not the doer
teach.text: يُشَخَّصُ المَرِيضُ, يُعَالَجُ المَرِيضُ, تُجْرَى العَمَلِيَّةُ. The affected noun becomes the nominative subject, and who performs the action is left out — standard in describing a healthcare system.

teach.title: يَصِفُ الدَّوَاءَ, not يُوصِفُ
teach.text: To prescribe is the Form I verb وَصَفَ / يَصِفُ: يَصِفُ الطَّبِيبُ الدَّوَاءَ. The passive is يُوصَفُ الدَّوَاءُ. The form يُوصِف is not standard.

grammar.title: Active and passive in healthcare
grammar.overview: Four active verbs with their complements, and the passive of each. The passive keeps the affected noun nominative.

rules.heading: Active treatment verbs
rules.formula: يُشَخِّصُ / يُعَالِجُ + object · يُحِيلُ إِلَى + genitive
rules.explanation: Most take a direct object; يُحِيلُ is fixed with إِلَى.

rules.heading: Forming the medical passive
rules.explanation: A ḍamma on the prefix, a fatḥa before the ending. The affected noun becomes nominative.

rules.heading: يَصِفُ and its passive
rules.explanation: وَصَفَ is Form I; its passive follows the regular pattern.

rules.heading: Narrating an experience
rules.explanation: Describe what happened, what generally happens, and what would follow.
examples: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الطَّوَارِئِ، وَعَادَةً يُفْحَصُ المَرِيضُ سَرِيعًا

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate active sentence.
quiz.feedback: يُشَخِّصُ takes a direct object.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate passive.
quiz.feedback: The passive keeps the affected noun nominative.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُحِيلُ الطَّبِيبُ المَرِيضَ ___ مُتَخَصِّصٍ.
quiz.feedback: يُحِيلُ is fixed with إِلَى.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate prescribing sentence.
quiz.feedback: To prescribe is the Form I verb يَصِفُ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate passive of وَصَفَ.
quiz.feedback: The affected noun الدَّوَاءُ is the nominative subject.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate operation sentence.
quiz.feedback: العَمَلِيَّةُ is feminine and the nominative subject.

quiz.prompt: Complete a narrative: إِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الأَلَمُ، ___ مُتَخَصِّصًا.
quiz.feedback: A Type 1 result clause takes سَـ.

quiz.prompt: Which word names A&E?
quiz.feedback: غُرْفَةُ الطَّوَارِئِ is the emergency department.

grammar.common_error: Keeping the affected noun accusative after a passive verb, or using يُوصِف for prescribing. The passive subject is nominative, and to prescribe is يَصِفُ.
grammar.challenge: Write one active sentence and its passive equivalent about diagnosis or treatment.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: Prescribing is the Form I verb يَصِفُ.

mistakes.why: The passive subject is nominative.
To prescribe is the Form I verb يَصِفُ.
يُحِيلُ is fixed with إِلَى.

listening.title: Listening: how a visit works
listening.script: عِنْدَمَا يَشْعُرُ المَرِيضُ بِأَلَمٍ، يَذْهَبُ أَوَّلًا إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ العَامِّ. يُفْحَصُ المَرِيضُ، ثُمَّ يُشَخَّصُ المَرَضُ. وَإِذَا كَانَتِ الحَالَةُ بَسِيطَةً، يَصِفُ الطَّبِيبُ دَوَاءً وَيُعْطِي وَصْفَةً طِبِّيَّةً. أَمَّا إِذَا كَانَتِ الحَالَةُ مُعَقَّدَةً، فَيُحَالُ المَرِيضُ إِلَى مُتَخَصِّصٍ. وَفِي الطَّوَارِئِ يُعَالَجُ المَرْضَى حَسَبَ الأَوْلَوِيَّةِ، لَا حَسَبَ وَقْتِ الوُصُولِ. وَتُجْرَى الفُحُوصَاتُ الضَّرُورِيَّةُ بِسُرْعَةٍ. أَنَا ذَهَبْتُ العَامَ المَاضِيَ إِلَى العِيَادَةِ، وَعُولِجْتُ بِسُرْعَةٍ، وَكَانَتِ التَّجْرِبَةُ مُطَمْئِنَةً.

questions.prompt: Where does the patient go first?
questions.feedback: يَذْهَبُ أَوَّلًا إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ العَامِّ.

questions.prompt: What happens if the case is simple?
options: Medicine is prescribed with a prescription
questions.feedback: يَصِفُ الطَّبِيبُ دَوَاءً وَيُعْطِي وَصْفَةً طِبِّيَّةً.

questions.prompt: What happens if the case is complex?
options: The patient is referred to a specialist
questions.feedback: فَيُحَالُ المَرِيضُ إِلَى مُتَخَصِّصٍ.

questions.prompt: How are patients treated in A&E?
options: By priority, not by arrival time
questions.feedback: يُعَالَجُ المَرْضَى حَسَبَ الأَوْلَوِيَّةِ، لَا حَسَبَ وَقْتِ الوُصُولِ.

questions.prompt: How does the speaker describe their own experience?
questions.feedback: عُولِجْتُ بِسُرْعَةٍ، وَكَانَتِ التَّجْرِبَةُ مُطَمْئِنَةً.

reading.title: Reading: what a good system provides
reading.text: يَقُومُ نِظَامُ الرِّعَايَةِ الصِّحِّيَّةِ الجَيِّدُ عَلَى مَبْدَأِ الوُصُولِ العَادِلِ إِلَى العِلَاجِ. فَفِي كَثِيرٍ مِنَ البُلْدَانِ يُعَالَجُ المَرْضَى مَجَّانًا أَوْ بِتَكْلِفَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ. وَيَبْدَأُ المَسَارُ عِنْدَ الطَّبِيبِ العَامِّ، الَّذِي يُشَخِّصُ الحَالَاتِ البَسِيطَةَ وَيُحِيلُ المُعَقَّدَةَ إِلَى مُتَخَصِّصٍ. وَتُجْرَى الفُحُوصَاتُ وَالعَمَلِيَّاتُ فِي المُسْتَشْفَيَاتِ. وَإِذَا حَصَلَ المَرِيضُ عَلَى تَشْخِيصٍ مُبَكِّرٍ، فَسَتَزْدَادُ فُرَصُ الشِّفَاءِ. وَلَيْسَتِ الأَنْظِمَةُ مِثَالِيَّةً؛ فَبَعْضُهَا يُعَانِي مِنْ طُولِ قَوَائِمِ الانْتِظَارِ. وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ يَبْقَى الهَدَفُ وَاحِدًا: رِعَايَةٌ فِي مُتَنَاوَلِ الجَمِيعِ.

questions.prompt: What principle does a good system rest on?
questions.feedback: عَلَى مَبْدَأِ الوُصُولِ العَادِلِ إِلَى العِلَاجِ.

questions.prompt: How are patients treated in many countries?
questions.feedback: يُعَالَجُ المَرْضَى مَجَّانًا أَوْ بِتَكْلِفَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What does the GP do with complex cases?
questions.feedback: يُحِيلُ المُعَقَّدَةَ إِلَى مُتَخَصِّصٍ.

questions.prompt: What follows from early diagnosis?
questions.feedback: فَسَتَزْدَادُ فُرَصُ الشِّفَاءِ.

questions.prompt: What does the text admit about systems?
options: They are not perfect; some have long waiting lists
questions.feedback: وَلَيْسَتِ الأَنْظِمَةُ مِثَالِيَّةً؛ فَبَعْضُهَا يُعَانِي مِنْ طُولِ قَوَائِمِ الانْتِظَارِ.

prompts: صِفْ مَا يَحْدُثُ عِنْدَ زِيَارَةِ الطَّبِيبِ. اِسْتَعْمِلْ فِعْلًا مَبْنِيًّا لِلْمَجْهُولِ.
مَاذَا يَحْدُثُ إِذَا كَانَتِ الحَالَةُ مُعَقَّدَةً؟
صِفْ تَجْرِبَةً صِحِّيَّةً مَرَرْتَ بِهَا.
model: صِفْ مَا يَحْدُثُ عِنْدَ زِيَارَةِ الطَّبِيبِ.
يُفْحَصُ المَرِيضُ أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ يُشَخَّصُ المَرَضُ وَيُوصَفُ الدَّوَاءُ.
إِذَا كَانَتْ مُعَقَّدَةً، يُحَالُ المَرِيضُ إِلَى مُتَخَصِّصٍ، وَقَدْ تُجْرَى لَهُ عَمَلِيَّةٌ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words describing a healthcare pathway or a personal experience. Use at least three medical passives, one referral with يُحِيلُ إِلَى, and a conditional, moving between past, present and future.
checklist: Three medical passives with nominative subjects.
One referral with يُحِيلُ إِلَى or يُحَالُ إِلَى.
One Type 1 conditional.
A clean move between past, present and future.
writing.model: عِنْدَمَا يَشْعُرُ المَرِيضُ بِأَلَمٍ، يَذْهَبُ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ العَامِّ. يُفْحَصُ المَرِيضُ أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ يُشَخَّصُ المَرَضُ. وَإِذَا كَانَتِ الحَالَةُ بَسِيطَةً، يُوصَفُ دَوَاءٌ مُنَاسِبٌ. أَمَّا إِذَا كَانَتْ مُعَقَّدَةً، فَيُحَالُ المَرِيضُ إِلَى مُتَخَصِّصٍ، وَقَدْ تُجْرَى لَهُ فُحُوصَاتٌ إِضَافِيَّةٌ. أَنَا ذَهَبْتُ العَامَ المَاضِيَ إِلَى العِيَادَةِ بَعْدَ إِصَابَةٍ بَسِيطَةٍ، وَعُولِجْتُ بِسُرْعَةٍ، وَكَانَتِ الرِّعَايَةُ جَيِّدَةً. وَإِذَا حَصَلَ المَرِيضُ عَلَى تَشْخِيصٍ مُبَكِّرٍ، فَسَتَزْدَادُ فُرَصُ الشِّفَاءِ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأَحْرِصُ عَلَى الفُحُوصَاتِ الدَّوْرِيَّةِ.

lessons.title: Public Health Campaigns — Persuasive Health Communication
lessons.arabic: حَمَلَاتُ الصِّحَّةِ العَامَّةِ — التَّوَاصُلُ الصِّحِّيُّ الإِقْنَاعِيُّ
lessons.summary: Engage a reader with rhetorical questions, use persuasive verbs, and write a public health campaign text with a clear call to action.
objectives: Engage the reader with هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ and أَلَا تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ.
Use يُحَذِّرُ مِنْ، يَدْعُو إِلَى، يُشَجِّعُ عَلَى with correct complements.
Structure a persuasive message: hook, argument, call to action.
Write a 100-110 word campaign text with a clear call to action.
success: I open with a rhetorical question that has an accusative noun after أَنَّ.
I follow each persuasive verb with its own preposition.
I end with a clear دَعْوَةٌ إِلَى العَمَلِ.
I persuade with evidence rather than fear alone.

teach.title: A rhetorical question hooks the reader
teach.text: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ نِصْفَ حَالَاتِ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ يُمْكِنُ الوِقَايَةُ مِنْهَا؟ The noun after أَنَّ is accusative (نِصْفَ). This opening draws the reader in before the argument arrives.

teach.title: Persuade with evidence, close with action
teach.text: A strong campaign names a fact, gives a reason, and ends with a clear call: لِنَبْدَأِ الآنَ or الخِيَارُ بِيَدِكَ. Fear alone persuades less than evidence plus a concrete next step.

grammar.title: Rhetoric, persuasion and the call to action
grammar.overview: Rhetorical openers with أَنَّ, persuasive verbs with fixed prepositions, and the structure of a campaign message.

rules.heading: Rhetorical openers
rules.explanation: أَنَّ makes the following noun accusative; the predicate stays nominative.
examples: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
أَلَا تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الحَرَكَةَ تُطِيلُ العُمُرَ؟

rules.heading: Persuasive verbs
rules.formula: يُحَذِّرُ مِنْ · يَدْعُو إِلَى · يُشَجِّعُ عَلَى
rules.explanation: Each has a fixed preposition and a genitive complement.

rules.heading: Direct-object persuaders
rules.explanation: These take a direct object with no preposition.

rules.heading: The call to action
rules.explanation: Close with a clear, concrete next step.

quiz.prompt: Complete: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ___ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
quiz.feedback: أَنَّ makes the following noun accusative.

quiz.prompt: Complete: تَدْعُو الرِّسَالَةُ ___ نَمَطِ حَيَاةٍ صِحِّيٍّ.

quiz.feedback: يُشَجِّعُ is fixed with عَلَى.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with يُحَفِّزُ.
quiz.feedback: يُحَفِّزُ takes a direct object, then عَلَى for the action.

quiz.feedback: A call to action names a concrete next step.

options: أَلَا تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الحَرَكَةَ تُطِيلُ العُمُرَ؟

options: تَدْعُو إِلَى الوِقَايَةِ وَتُقَدِّمُ خُطُوَاتٍ عَمَلِيَّةً.
quiz.feedback: It offers evidence and a practical step, not fear alone.

grammar.common_error: Swapping the persuasive prepositions, or keeping the noun after أَنَّ nominative. أَنَّ takes an accusative noun.

patterns.ar: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
patterns.label: What to notice

mistakes.wrong: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمُ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
mistakes.right: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
mistakes.why: أَنَّ takes an accusative noun.
يُحَذِّرُ requires مِنْ.
يَدْعُو requires إِلَى.

listening.title: Listening: a campaign message
listening.script: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ثَلَاثِينَ دَقِيقَةً مِنَ المَشْيِ يَوْمِيًّا تُقَلِّلُ مِنْ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضٍ كَثِيرَةٍ؟ تُحَذِّرُ حَمْلَتُنَا مِنَ الجُلُوسِ الطَّوِيلِ، وَتَدْعُو إِلَى نَمَطِ حَيَاةٍ أَكْثَرَ حَرَكَةً. لَا نَطْلُبُ تَغْيِيرًا كَبِيرًا؛ بَلْ خُطْوَةً صَغِيرَةً كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. تُشَجِّعُ الرِّسَالَةُ الشَّبَابَ عَلَى اسْتِعْمَالِ الدَّرَجِ بَدَلَ المِصْعَدِ، وَعَلَى المَشْيِ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ. وَإِذَا بَدَأْتَ اليَوْمَ، سَتَشْعُرُ بِالفَرْقِ خِلَالَ أَسَابِيعَ. الخِيَارُ بِيَدِكَ، وَمَعًا نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَبْنِيَ عَادَاتٍ أَفْضَلَ.

questions.prompt: What does the rhetorical opener ask about?
options: Thirty minutes of walking reducing disease risk
questions.feedback: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ثَلَاثِينَ دَقِيقَةً مِنَ المَشْيِ … تُقَلِّلُ مِنْ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضٍ؟

questions.prompt: What does the campaign warn against?
questions.feedback: تُحَذِّرُ حَمْلَتُنَا مِنَ الجُلُوسِ الطَّوِيلِ.

questions.prompt: How big a change does it ask for?
questions.feedback: لَا نَطْلُبُ تَغْيِيرًا كَبِيرًا؛ بَلْ خُطْوَةً صَغِيرَةً كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.

questions.prompt: What does it encourage young people to do?
options: Use the stairs instead of the lift, and walk to school
questions.feedback: تُشَجِّعُ … عَلَى اسْتِعْمَالِ الدَّرَجِ بَدَلَ المِصْعَدِ، وَعَلَى المَشْيِ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ.

questions.prompt: How does it close?
options: The choice is yours; together we can build better habits
questions.feedback: الخِيَارُ بِيَدِكَ، وَمَعًا نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَبْنِيَ عَادَاتٍ أَفْضَلَ.

reading.title: Reading: what makes a campaign work
reading.text: تَنْجَحُ الحَمْلَةُ الصِّحِّيَّةُ عِنْدَمَا تَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الوُضُوحِ وَالمِصْدَاقِيَّةِ. فَالرِّسَالَةُ الغَامِضَةُ لَا تُقْنِعُ، وَالتَّخْوِيفُ وَحْدَهُ لَا يَدُومُ أَثَرُهُ. لِذٰلِكَ تَبْدَأُ الحَمَلَاتُ الجَيِّدَةُ بِمَعْلُومَةٍ صَادِمَةٍ لٰكِنْ صَحِيحَةٍ، ثُمَّ تَدْعُو إِلَى خُطْوَةٍ عَمَلِيَّةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ. وَتُحَفِّزُ الجُمْهُورَ بِلُغَةٍ إِيجَابِيَّةٍ، لَا بِاللَّوْمِ. وَتَنْتَشِرُ الرِّسَالَةُ بِسُرْعَةٍ عَبْرَ وَسَائِلِ التَّوَاصُلِ إِذَا كَانَتْ قَصِيرَةً وَقَابِلَةً لِلتَّطْبِيقِ. وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ إِخَافَةَ النَّاسِ، بَلْ تَمْكِينَهُمْ مِنَ اتِّخَاذِ قَرَارٍ أَفْضَلَ. وَتَخْتَلِفُ الرِّسَالَةُ الأَنْجَحُ بِاخْتِلَافِ الجُمْهُورِ المُسْتَهْدَفِ.

When it is long and detailed

questions.feedback: وَتُحَفِّزُ الجُمْهُورَ بِلُغَةٍ إِيجَابِيَّةٍ، لَا بِاللَّوْمِ.

Persuasive verbs plus a call to action

writing.prompt: Write a 100-110 word public health campaign text on a topic of your choice. Open with a rhetorical question, warn against one habit, call for a healthier one, and close with a clear call to action.
checklist: A rhetorical opener with هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ and an accusative noun.
One يُحَذِّرُ مِنْ and one يَدْعُو إِلَى, with correct prepositions.
One يُشَجِّعُ عَلَى or يُحَفِّزُ with the right complement.
A clear call to action to close.
writing.model: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ثَلَاثِينَ دَقِيقَةً مِنَ الحَرَكَةِ يَوْمِيًّا تُقَلِّلُ مِنْ خَطَرِ أَمْرَاضٍ كَثِيرَةٍ؟ تُحَذِّرُ حَمْلَتُنَا مِنَ الجُلُوسِ الطَّوِيلِ أَمَامَ الشَّاشَاتِ، وَتَدْعُو إِلَى نَمَطِ حَيَاةٍ أَكْثَرَ نَشَاطًا. لَا نَطْلُبُ مِنْكَ تَغْيِيرًا كَبِيرًا، بَلْ خُطْوَةً صَغِيرَةً: اِسْتَعْمِلِ الدَّرَجَ بَدَلَ المِصْعَدِ، وَامْشِ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ. تُشَجِّعُ الرِّسَالَةُ الشَّبَابَ عَلَى الحَرَكَةِ بِلُغَةٍ إِيجَابِيَّةٍ لَا بِاللَّوْمِ. وَإِذَا بَدَأْتَ اليَوْمَ، سَتَشْعُرُ بِالفَرْقِ خِلَالَ أَسَابِيعَ. تَذَكَّرْ أَنَّ التَّغْيِيرَ يَبْدَأُ بِقَرَارٍ وَاحِدٍ. الخِيَارُ بِيَدِكَ، وَمَعًا نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَبْنِيَ عَادَاتٍ أَفْضَلَ. لِنَبْدَأِ الآنَ.

It offers a practical step, not fear.

rounds.prompt: Close: which is a call to action?
rounds.feedback: لِنَبْدَأِ الآنَ calls the reader to act.
رِسَالَة is feminine and nominative here.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which campaign line is the most complete?
options: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ المَشْيَ يُقَلِّلُ مِنْ خَطَرِ الأَمْرَاضِ؟ اِبْدَأْ بِخُطْوَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ اليَوْمَ.
تُحَذِّرُ الحَمْلَةُ عَلَى الجُلُوسِ وَتَدْعُو عَلَى الحَرَكَةِ.
rounds.feedback: It opens rhetorically, states a benefit and closes with a call to action.

live_builder.target: Build a campaign from a rhetorical hook, a persuasive line and a call to action.
groups: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ المَشْيَ يُطِيلُ العُمُرَ؟
هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
أَلَا تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الحَرَكَةَ تُحَسِّنُ المِزَاجَ؟
تُشَجِّعُ عَلَى خُطْوَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ
وَمَعًا نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَبْنِيَ عَادَاتٍ أَفْضَلَ
live_builder.feedback: Each hook, persuasive line and call to action is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.title: Fix the case after أَنَّ
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the noun that follows أَنَّ.
builder_tasks.source: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمُ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
options: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ النَّوْمِ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنْ النَّوْمَ يُقَوِّي المَنَاعَةَ؟
builder_tasks.feedback: أَنَّ takes an accusative noun.

builder_tasks.title: Repair the persuasive preposition
builder_tasks.instruction: Correct the complement after يُحَذِّرُ.
builder_tasks.feedback: يُحَذِّرُ is fixed with مِنْ.

builder_tasks.title: Add a call to action
builder_tasks.instruction: Replace the flat ending with a call to action.
builder_tasks.feedback: A call to action names a concrete next step.

lessons.title: Reading — Health and Wellbeing Texts
lessons.summary: Read authentic health texts closely: spot passives and conditionals, separate fact from opinion, judge a source, and infer the writer's attitude.
objectives: Identify medical passives and conditionals inside a running text.
Distinguish a fact from an opinion.
Judge the reliability of a source and spot bias.
Infer an implicit attitude the writer does not state directly (R3).
success: I can point to a passive verb and name what is affected.
I separate a checkable fact from a personal judgement.
I ask where a claim comes from and whether the source is reliable.
I read attitude from word choice, not only from explicit statements.

teach.title: A fact can be checked; an opinion is held
teach.text: مِنَ المُؤَكَّدِ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُنَظِّمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ is a checkable claim about the world. أَرَى أَنَّ السَّهَرَ مُمْتِعٌ is a personal judgement. Watch the signal phrase: يَرَى أَنَّ and أَعْتَقِدُ mark opinion; يُشِيرُ إِلَى أَنَّ and تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَةُ mark reported evidence.

teach.title: Attitude is often implicit
teach.text: A writer rarely says أَنَا قَلِقٌ. Instead word choice carries it: calling something خَطَرًا مُتَزَايِدًا or أَزْمَةً signals worry; لِحُسْنِ الحَظِّ signals relief. R3 asks you to read the attitude behind the words, not only the words themselves.

grammar.title: Reading closely: structure, fact, source and attitude
grammar.arabic: القِرَاءَةُ الفَاحِصَةُ — البِنْيَةُ وَالحَقِيقَةُ وَالمَصْدَرُ وَالمَوْقِفُ
grammar.overview: A skills toolkit rather than one new rule: recognise passives and conditionals in context, sort fact from opinion, weigh a source, and infer attitude.

rules.heading: Structure in context
rules.explanation: Spot يُشَخَّصُ / يُعَالَجُ and إِذَا … سَـ inside a running text and say what each does.
examples: يُعَالَجُ المَرْضَى مَجَّانًا — passive, no named doer
إِذَا نَامَ الطِّفْلُ مُبَكِّرًا، سَيَنْشَطُ — a real condition

rules.heading: Fact vs opinion
rules.explanation: Let the framing verb tell you which you are reading.

rules.heading: Weighing a source
rules.explanation: Ask who makes the claim and on what evidence; note bias and exaggeration.
examples: تَعْتَمِدُ المَقَالَةُ عَلَى دِرَاسَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ → more reliable

rules.heading: Inferring attitude (R3)
rules.explanation: Read tone from loaded words, not only explicit statements.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence is a fact rather than an opinion?
options: تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَةُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُنَظِّمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ.
quiz.feedback: It reports a study finding, which can be checked.

quiz.prompt: Which phrase signals an opinion?
quiz.feedback: يَرَى أَنَّ frames a personal judgement.

quiz.prompt: In “يُعَالَجُ المَرْضَى مَجَّانًا”, what is the structure?
options: A passive with no named doer
quiz.feedback: يُعَالَجُ is a passive; the doer is unnamed.

quiz.prompt: Which makes a source more reliable?
options: It makes a claim with no evidence
quiz.feedback: Evidence from a study raises reliability.

quiz.prompt: A writer calls a health issue أَزْمَةً مُتَفَاقِمَةً. What attitude is implied?
quiz.feedback: The loaded words signal worry, an implicit attitude.

quiz.prompt: Which word means “bias”?
quiz.feedback: تَحَيُّزٌ is bias.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence hedges rather than asserts?
quiz.feedback: يَبْدُو أَنَّ marks a tentative claim.

quiz.prompt: What is the best first question to judge a claim?
options: Who said it and on what evidence?
quiz.feedback: Source and evidence decide reliability.

grammar.common_error: Treating any confident sentence as a fact. Certainty of tone is not evidence; check the source and the framing verb.
grammar.challenge: Take one health sentence and rewrite it once as a fact and once as an opinion, changing only the signal phrase.

patterns.ar: تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَةُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُنَظِّمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ
patterns.label: What to notice

mistakes.why: أَرَى أَنَّ frames a personal judgement, not a fact.
A claim without a source is weak, not reliable.

mistakes.wrong: النَّبْرَةُ القَلِقَةُ تَظْهَرُ دَائِمًا بِشَكْلٍ صَرِيحٍ.
mistakes.right: النَّبْرَةُ القَلِقَةُ قَدْ تَظْهَرُ بِشَكْلٍ ضِمْنِيٍّ.
mistakes.why: Attitude is often implicit, carried by word choice.

listening.title: Listening: reading a claim critically
listening.script: عِنْدَمَا تَقْرَأُ خَبَرًا صِحِّيًّا، لَا تُصَدِّقْ كُلَّ ادِّعَاءٍ فَوْرًا. اِسْأَلْ أَوَّلًا: مَنْ قَالَ هٰذَا؟ وَبِأَيِّ دَلِيلٍ؟ فَالجُمْلَةُ الَّتِي تَبْدَأُ بِـ«تُظْهِرُ دِرَاسَةٌ عِلْمِيَّةٌ» أَقْوَى مِنْ جُمْلَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِـ«يَقُولُ النَّاسُ». وَمَيِّزْ بَيْنَ الحَقِيقَةِ وَالرَّأْيِ: «يُنَظِّمُ النَّوْمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ» حَقِيقَةٌ مَدْعُومَةٌ، أَمَّا «السَّهَرُ مُمْتِعٌ» فَرَأْيٌ. وَانْتَبِهْ لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ وَالتَّحَيُّزِ. وَأَحْيَانًا يُخْفِي الكَاتِبُ مَوْقِفَهُ فِي اخْتِيَارِ الكَلِمَاتِ، فَوَصْفُ الوَضْعِ بِأَنَّهُ «أَزْمَةٌ» يَكْشِفُ قَلَقَهُ دُونَ أَنْ يُصَرِّحَ بِهِ.

questions.prompt: What should you not do with every claim?
questions.feedback: لَا تُصَدِّقْ كُلَّ ادِّعَاءٍ فَوْرًا.

questions.prompt: What are the first questions to ask?
options: Who said it and on what evidence
Who published it and when only
questions.feedback: مَنْ قَالَ هٰذَا؟ وَبِأَيِّ دَلِيلٍ؟

questions.prompt: Which opening is stronger?
questions.feedback: «تُظْهِرُ دِرَاسَةٌ عِلْمِيَّةٌ» أَقْوَى مِنْ «يَقُولُ النَّاسُ».

questions.prompt: “السَّهَرُ مُمْتِعٌ” is presented as what?
questions.feedback: «السَّهَرُ مُمْتِعٌ» فَرَأْيٌ.

questions.prompt: How can a writer hide their stance?
questions.feedback: يُخْفِي الكَاتِبُ مَوْقِفَهُ فِي اخْتِيَارِ الكَلِمَاتِ.

reading.title: Reading: two claims about screens
reading.text: اِقْرَأِ الفِقْرَتَيْنِ التَّالِيَتَيْنِ. الأُولَى: «تُشِيرُ دِرَاسَةٌ حَدِيثَةٌ نُشِرَتْ فِي مَجَلَّةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ إِلَى أَنَّ اسْتِعْمَالَ الشَّاشَاتِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ يُؤَخِّرُ النَّوْمَ بِنَحْوِ عِشْرِينَ دَقِيقَةً فِي المُتَوَسِّطِ.» وَالثَّانِيَةُ: «الشَّاشَاتُ كَارِثَةٌ حَقِيقِيَّةٌ تُدَمِّرُ جِيلًا بِأَكْمَلِهِ، وَلَا يُمْكِنُ إِنْقَاذُهُ إِلَّا بِمَنْعِهَا تَمَامًا.» الفِقْرَةُ الأُولَى تُقَدِّمُ نَتِيجَةَ دِرَاسَةٍ مَعَ مَصْدَرٍ وَرَقَمٍ، فَهِيَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى الحَقِيقَةِ. أَمَّا الثَّانِيَةُ فَتَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى كَلِمَاتٍ مُبَالَغٍ فِيهَا مِثْلَ «كَارِثَةٌ» وَ«تُدَمِّرُ»، وَتَكْشِفُ مَوْقِفًا مُتَحَيِّزًا دُونَ دَلِيلٍ. القَارِئُ النَّاقِدُ يَثِقُ بِالأُولَى أَكْثَرَ، وَيَشُكُّ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ.

questions.prompt: What does the first paragraph rest on?
options: A study finding with a source and a number
questions.feedback: تُقَدِّمُ نَتِيجَةَ دِرَاسَةٍ مَعَ مَصْدَرٍ وَرَقَمٍ.

questions.prompt: How does the second paragraph argue?
options: With exaggerated words and no evidence
questions.feedback: تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى كَلِمَاتٍ مُبَالَغٍ فِيهَا … دُونَ دَلِيلٍ.

questions.prompt: Which words signal the writer's bias in paragraph two?
questions.feedback: كَلِمَاتٌ مُبَالَغٌ فِيهَا مِثْلَ «كَارِثَةٌ» وَ«تُدَمِّرُ».

questions.prompt: Which paragraph is closer to fact?
questions.feedback: فَهِيَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى الحَقِيقَةِ.

questions.prompt: What does the critical reader do?
options: Trusts the first more and doubts the second
questions.feedback: يَثِقُ بِالأُولَى أَكْثَرَ، وَيَشُكُّ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ.

speaking.context: Speaking: judge a health claim aloud
prompts: اِقْرَأِ ادِّعَاءً صِحِّيًّا. هَلْ هُوَ حَقِيقَةٌ أَمْ رَأْيٌ؟ كَيْفَ عَرَفْتَ؟
مَا الأَسْئِلَةُ الَّتِي تَطْرَحُهَا عَنِ المَصْدَرِ؟
كَيْفَ تَسْتَنْتِجُ مَوْقِفَ الكَاتِبِ إِذَا لَمْ يُصَرِّحْ بِهِ؟
model: هٰذِهِ الجُمْلَةُ حَقِيقَةٌ أَمْ رَأْيٌ: «الشَّاشَاتُ كَارِثَةٌ»؟
رَأْيٌ مُتَحَيِّزٌ؛ فَكَلِمَةُ «كَارِثَةٌ» مُبَالَغَةٌ بِلَا دَلِيلٍ.
Names the signal and the bias
أَسْأَلُ مَنِ الكَاتِبُ وَبِأَيِّ دَلِيلٍ، وَأَثِقُ أَكْثَرَ بِدِرَاسَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ لَهَا مَصْدَرٌ وَاضِحٌ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words analysing a short health text of your choice. Name one fact and one opinion in it, judge its source, and state the writer's attitude, saying whether it is explicit or implicit.
checklist: One sentence identified as a fact and one as an opinion, with the signal phrase.
A judgement of the source using مَصْدَر, دَلِيل or تَحَيُّز.
A statement of the writer's attitude (مَوْقِف / نَبْرَة).
A note on whether that attitude is explicit or implicit.
writing.model: يَجْمَعُ النَّصُّ بَيْنَ الحَقِيقَةِ وَالرَّأْيِ. فَجُمْلَةُ «تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَةُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُنَظِّمُ الذَّاكِرَةَ» حَقِيقَةٌ مَدْعُومَةٌ بِمَصْدَرٍ، أَمَّا «السَّهَرُ مُمْتِعٌ» فَرَأْيٌ شَخْصِيٌّ يَبْدَأُ بِـ«أَرَى أَنَّ». وَعِنْدَ تَقْيِيمِ المَصْدَرِ، أَجِدُ أَنَّ الكَاتِبَ يَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى دِرَاسَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ وَاضِحَةٍ، فَتَزْدَادُ مَوْثُوقِيَّتُهُ. وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ تَكْشِفُ كَلِمَاتُهُ مَوْقِفًا قَلِقًا، إِذْ يَصِفُ الوَضْعَ بِأَنَّهُ «خَطَرٌ مُتَزَايِدٌ». هٰذَا المَوْقِفُ ضِمْنِيٌّ، لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُصَرِّحْ بِقَلَقِهِ، بَلْ تَرَكَ الكَلِمَاتِ تَكْشِفُهُ. لِذٰلِكَ أَقْرَأُ النَّصَّ بِثِقَةٍ حَذِرَةٍ.

differentiation.core: Sort six health sentences into fact and opinion using the signal phrases.
differentiation.develop: Add a source judgement for two of them.
differentiation.stretch: Infer the writer's implicit attitude from word choice and justify it.

options: تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَةُ أَنَّ الحَرَكَةَ تُحَسِّنُ المِزَاجَ.
final.feedback: It reports a study finding, which can be checked.

final.prompt: Which phrase raises a source's reliability?
final.feedback: Evidence from a study raises reliability.

final.prompt: A writer calls a trend خَطَرًا مُتَزَايِدًا. The implied attitude is:
final.feedback: The loaded phrase signals worry, an implicit attitude.

options: الفِقْرَةُ الأُولَى حَقِيقَةٌ مَدْعُومَةٌ بِمَصْدَرٍ، وَالثَّانِيَةُ رَأْيٌ مُتَحَيِّزٌ بِلَا دَلِيلٍ.
final.feedback: It separates supported fact from unsupported, biased opinion.

mission.title: Critical Reading Mission — Fact, Source and Attitude
mission.intro: Sort fact from opinion, weigh the source, and read the attitude behind the words.

rounds.prompt: Fact or opinion: «تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَةُ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ مُفِيدٌ».
rounds.feedback: A reported study finding is a fact.

rounds.prompt: Fact or opinion: «أَرَى أَنَّ السَّهَرَ مُمْتِعٌ».
Signal: which phrase marks reported evidence?

rounds.feedback: A cited study is more reliable.

rounds.prompt: Explicit or implicit: attitude carried only by word choice is …
rounds.feedback: Attitude from word choice is implicit.

rounds.prompt: Best question to test a claim:
options: Who said it and on what evidence?

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which is the most complete critical judgement?
options: الجُمْلَةُ رَأْيٌ مُتَحَيِّزٌ؛ فَهِيَ بِلَا مَصْدَرٍ وَتُبَالِغُ فِي الوَصْفِ.
rounds.feedback: It names the category, the missing source and the exaggeration.

live_builder.target: Build a critical judgement from a category, a source note and an attitude reading.
live_builder.feedback: Each category, source note and attitude reading stands on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.title: Reclassify the opinion
builder_tasks.instruction: Correct the label of this sentence.
builder_tasks.feedback: أَرَى أَنَّ frames an opinion.

builder_tasks.title: Fix the source judgement
builder_tasks.instruction: Correct the claim about reliability.
builder_tasks.feedback: A claim without a source is weak.

builder_tasks.title: Name the attitude as implicit
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the statement about how attitude appears.
builder_tasks.source: يَظْهَرُ المَوْقِفُ القَلِقُ دَائِمًا بِشَكْلٍ صَرِيحٍ.
options: قَدْ يَظْهَرُ المَوْقِفُ القَلِقُ بِشَكْلٍ ضِمْنِيٍّ.
builder_tasks.feedback: Attitude is often implicit, carried by word choice.

lessons.title: Writing — Healthy Lifestyles (Paper 4 Extended Writing)
lessons.summary: Assemble the nine P1 Range criteria into a structured 140-150 word health article, and mark it against the Paper 4 Q3 scheme.
objectives: Plan a four-paragraph health article: hook, diet, exercise and mental health, conclusion.
Combine conditional, passive, rhetorical question and academic vocabulary in one text.
Use formal connectors and statistical language to raise the register.
Self-assess against the nine Range criteria and reach at least seven.
success: I open with a rhetorical question and a statistic.
I include a Type 1 conditional and a medical passive, both accurate.
I join ideas with formal connectors, not only وَ.
I count my Range markers and reach seven or more.

teach.title: One sophisticated sentence can carry two Range markers
teach.text: إِذَا اتَّبَعْتَ حِمْيَةً مُتَوَازِنَةً، سَتَنْخَفِضُ نِسْبَةُ الإِصَابَةِ بِأَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ combines a conditional with statistical language. Aim for sentences that do two jobs at once — that is double Range value in one line.

teach.title: Structure the article in four moves
teach.text: P1 a rhetorical hook plus a statistic; P2 diet with academic vocabulary and a passive; P3 exercise and mental health with a Form II verb and a conditional; P4 an opinion and a forward look joined by a formal connector. The plan is what turns vocabulary into a Level A text.

grammar.title: Assembling the P1 Range
grammar.arabic: تَرْكِيبُ النِّطَاقِ اللُّغَوِيِّ فِي السَّنَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ
grammar.overview: Not a new rule but a synthesis: how to combine the P1 structures and raise register with connectors and statistical language.

rules.heading: Hook with question plus statistic
rules.explanation: Open with a rhetorical question carrying a number.
examples: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ثُلُثَ المُرَاهِقِينَ لَا يَنَامُونَ كِفَايَةً؟

rules.heading: Combine conditional and statistic
rules.explanation: Pack two Range markers into one sentence.

listening.title: Listening: an examiner explains Range
listening.script: فِي الوَرَقَةِ الرَّابِعَةِ، السُّؤَالُ الثَّالِثُ يُقَيِّمُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْيَاءَ: المُحْتَوَى، وَالنِّطَاقَ، وَالدِّقَّةَ. النِّطَاقُ يَعْنِي تَنَوُّعَ البُنَى: جُمْلَةٌ شَرْطِيَّةٌ، وَمَبْنِيٌّ لِلْمَجْهُولِ، وَسُؤَالٌ بَلَاغِيٌّ، وَرَابِطٌ رَسْمِيٌّ. لَا يَكْفِي أَنْ تَكْتُبَ مِئَةً وَخَمْسِينَ كَلِمَةً بِبُنْيَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مُكَرَّرَةٍ. اُكْتُبْ مِئَةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ إِلَى مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ كَلِمَةً، وَاجْعَلْ كُلَّ فِقْرَةٍ تَحْمِلُ عَلَامَةَ نِطَاقٍ جَدِيدَةً. اِفْتَحْ بِسُؤَالٍ بَلَاغِيٍّ وَإِحْصَائِيَّةٍ، ثُمَّ اسْتَعْمِلْ فِعْلًا مَبْنِيًّا لِلْمَجْهُولِ فِي فِقْرَةِ الغِذَاءِ، وَجُمْلَةً شَرْطِيَّةً فِي فِقْرَةِ الرِّيَاضَةِ. خِتَامًا، أَعْطِ رَأْيًا وَنَظْرَةً إِلَى المُسْتَقْبَلِ.

reading.text: هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ثُلُثَ المُرَاهِقِينَ لَا يَحْصُلُونَ عَلَى نَوْمٍ كَافٍ؟ إِنَّ الصِّحَّةَ الجَيِّدَةَ تَقُومُ عَلَى ثَلَاثَةِ أَرْكَانٍ. أَوَّلًا، الغِذَاءُ: يُوصَى بِتَنَاوُلِ طَعَامٍ غَنِيٍّ بِالخُضَارِ وَالبُرُوتِينِ، وَيَنْبَغِي تَقْلِيلُ الأَطْعِمَةِ المُصَنَّعَةِ. عِلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، تُقَوِّي الرِّيَاضَةُ الجِسْمَ وَتُحَسِّنُ المِزَاجَ؛ فَإِذَا مَارَسْتَ الرِّيَاضَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ أُسْبُوعِيًّا، سَتَنْخَفِضُ نِسْبَةُ التَّوَتُّرِ. عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ، يُهْمِلُ كَثِيرُونَ الرَّاحَةَ وَالنَّوْمَ. فِي رَأْيِي، التَّوَازُنُ بَيْنَ الغِذَاءِ وَالحَرَكَةِ وَالنَّوْمِ هُوَ المِفْتَاحُ. خِتَامًا، أَدْعُوكَ إِلَى خُطْوَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِهَا اليَوْمَ.

lessons.summary: Complete Paper 1 style health listening: catch conditionals and passives in fast speech, anchor statistics, and beat close distractors.
objectives: Predict which structure each question targets before listening.

teach.title: The passive has a ḍamma-then-fatḥa shape
teach.text: يُعَالِجُ (active, “treats”) has a kasra on the ل. يُعَالَجُ (passive, “is treated”) has a fatḥa. The prefix يُ carries a ḍamma in both, so listen for the vowel just before the last consonant: fatḥa signals the passive.

teach.title: Arabic numbers put the unit before the ten
teach.text: خَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ is 35 — you hear “five and thirty”. Learners who write 53 have reversed it. Hold the whole phrase before writing the figure, and let بِالْمِئَةِ anchor that it is a percentage.

grammar.title: Hearing structure in fast speech
grammar.overview: A listening toolkit: recognise the passive by its vowel shape, catch the conditional signal, and lock statistics down accurately.

rules.heading: Active vs passive by ear

rules.heading: Conditional signal

rules.heading: Statistical anchor
rules.explanation: The word بِالْمِئَةِ marks a percentage; hold the number before writing.

rules.heading: Distractor discipline

listening.title: Listening: a nutritionist on the Mediterranean diet
listening.script: يَقُولُ خَبِيرُ التَّغْذِيَةِ: تَعْتَمِدُ الحِمْيَةُ المُتَوَسِّطِيَّةُ عَلَى الخُضَارِ وَزَيْتِ الزَّيْتُونِ وَالحُبُوبِ الكَامِلَةِ. تُشِيرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ إِلَى أَنَّ هٰذِهِ الحِمْيَةَ تُقَلِّلُ خَطَرَ أَمْرَاضِ القَلْبِ بِنِسْبَةِ خَمْسَةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ بِالْمِئَةِ. وَإِذَا قَلَّلْتَ الأَطْعِمَةَ المُصَنَّعَةَ، سَتَنْخَفِضُ نِسْبَةُ الالْتِهَابِ فِي جِسْمِكَ. يُوصَى بِتَنَاوُلِ السَّمَكِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أُسْبُوعِيًّا. أَمَّا المُكَمِّلَاتُ الغِذَائِيَّةُ، فَيَرَى الخَبِيرُ أَنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بَدِيلًا عَنِ الطَّعَامِ الطَّبِيعِيِّ. وَعِنْدَ المُقَارَنَةِ، تَبْقَى الحِمْيَةُ المُتَوَازِنَةُ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَيِّ حُبُوبٍ مُكَمِّلَةٍ. خِتَامًا، يَنْصَحُ بِخُطْوَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ: اِسْتَبْدِلْ وَجْبَةً وَاحِدَةً مُصَنَّعَةً بِأُخْرَى طَازَجَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What does the Mediterranean diet rely on?
options: Vegetables, olive oil and whole grains
questions.feedback: تَعْتَمِدُ … عَلَى الخُضَارِ وَزَيْتِ الزَّيْتُونِ وَالحُبُوبِ الكَامِلَةِ.

questions.prompt: By what percentage does it reduce heart-disease risk?
questions.feedback: بِنِسْبَةِ خَمْسَةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ بِالْمِئَةِ = 35%.

questions.prompt: What follows from cutting processed foods?
questions.feedback: إِذَا قَلَّلْتَ الأَطْعِمَةَ المُصَنَّعَةَ، سَتَنْخَفِضُ نِسْبَةُ الالْتِهَابِ.

questions.prompt: What is the expert's view on supplements?
options: Not a substitute for natural food
questions.feedback: لَيْسَتْ بَدِيلًا عَنِ الطَّعَامِ الطَّبِيعِيِّ.

questions.prompt: What is the closing recommendation?
options: Swap one processed meal for a fresh one
questions.feedback: اِسْتَبْدِلْ وَجْبَةً وَاحِدَةً مُصَنَّعَةً بِأُخْرَى طَازَجَةٍ.

reading.title: Reading: a listening strategy guide
reading.text: لِتَنْجَحَ فِي الاسْتِمَاعِ الأَكَادِيمِيِّ، اقْرَأِ الأَسْئِلَةَ أَوَّلًا وَحَدِّدْ مَا يَطْلُبُهُ كُلُّ سُؤَالٍ. إِذَا طَلَبَ السُّؤَالُ إِحْصَائِيَّةً، فَانْتَظِرْ رَقْمًا مَعَ كَلِمَةِ «بِالْمِئَةِ». وَإِذَا طَلَبَ عَلَاقَةً شَرْطِيَّةً، فَاسْتَمِعْ إِلَى «إِذَا» وَإِلَى الفِعْلِ فِي جُمْلَةِ الجَوَابِ. أَمَّا الإِجْرَاءُ الطِّبِّيُّ، فَيَظْهَرُ فِي فِعْلٍ مَبْنِيٍّ لِلْمَجْهُولِ مِثْلِ «يُشَخَّصُ» أَوْ «يُعَالَجُ». اِنْتَبِهْ إِلَى الأَرْقَامِ العَرَبِيَّةِ: تُقَالُ الآحَادُ قَبْلَ العَشَرَاتِ، فَـ«خَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ» تَعْنِي خَمْسَةً وَثَلَاثِينَ لَا ثَلَاثَةً وَخَمْسِينَ. وَتَذَكَّرْ أَنَّ الإِجَابَةَ العَامَّةَ كَثِيرًا مَا تَكُونُ مُشَتِّتًا؛ فَالإِجَابَةُ الصَّحِيحَةُ عَادَةً مُحَدَّدَةٌ وَمَرْبُوطَةٌ بِالنَّصِّ.

questions.prompt: What is the first strategy step?
options: Read the questions and identify what each asks
questions.feedback: اقْرَأِ الأَسْئِلَةَ أَوَّلًا وَحَدِّدْ مَا يَطْلُبُهُ كُلُّ سُؤَالٍ.

questions.prompt: What signals a statistic?
options: A number with the word بِالْمِئَةِ
questions.feedback: فَانْتَظِرْ رَقْمًا مَعَ كَلِمَةِ «بِالْمِئَةِ».

questions.prompt: How does a medical procedure appear?
options: In a passive verb like يُشَخَّصُ
questions.feedback: يَظْهَرُ فِي فِعْلٍ مَبْنِيٍّ لِلْمَجْهُولِ مِثْلِ «يُشَخَّصُ».

questions.prompt: What does خَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ mean?
questions.feedback: تُقَالُ الآحَادُ قَبْلَ العَشَرَاتِ: 35.

questions.prompt: What is often a distractor?
questions.feedback: الإِجَابَةُ العَامَّةُ كَثِيرًا مَا تَكُونُ مُشَتِّتًا.

prompts: مَا الإِحْصَائِيَّةُ الَّتِي سَمِعْتَهَا؟ وَبِأَيِّ كَلِمَةٍ عَرَفْتَهَا؟
مَا الجُمْلَةُ الشَّرْطِيَّةُ الَّتِي قَالَهَا الخَبِيرُ؟
كَيْفَ تُمَيِّزُ المَبْنِيَّ لِلْمَجْهُولِ فِي الكَلَامِ؟
model: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ الحِمْيَةَ تُقَلِّلُ الخَطَرَ بِنِسْبَةِ خَمْسَةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ بِالْمِئَةِ، وَعَرَفْتُهَا مِنْ كَلِمَةِ بِالْمِئَةِ.
سَمِعْتُ «يُوصَى بِـ»، وَالفَتْحَةُ قَبْلَ الآخِرِ دَلَّتْ عَلَى المَجْهُولِ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words explaining your listening strategy for academic health texts. Describe how you predict, how you tell a passive from an active by ear, and how you avoid reversing Arabic numbers.
checklist: A prediction step: match each question to its cue word.
The passive cue: a fatḥa before the last consonant.
The number rule: units are said before tens.
A note on rejecting the general distractor.
writing.model: قَبْلَ الاسْتِمَاعِ، أَقْرَأُ الأَسْئِلَةَ وَأُحَدِّدُ مَا يَطْلُبُهُ كُلُّ سُؤَالٍ: إِحْصَائِيَّةً أَمْ عَلَاقَةً شَرْطِيَّةً أَمْ إِجْرَاءً طِبِّيًّا. إِذَا كَانَ السُّؤَالُ عَنْ إِحْصَائِيَّةٍ، أَنْتَظِرُ رَقْمًا مَعَ كَلِمَةِ «بِالْمِئَةِ». وَأُمَيِّزُ المَبْنِيَّ لِلْمَجْهُولِ مِنَ الفَتْحَةِ قَبْلَ الحَرْفِ الأَخِيرِ، فَـ«يُعَالَجُ» مَجْهُولٌ وَ«يُعَالِجُ» مَعْلُومٌ. وَأَنْتَبِهُ إِلَى الأَرْقَامِ العَرَبِيَّةِ لِأَنَّ الآحَادَ تُقَالُ قَبْلَ العَشَرَاتِ، فَـ«خَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ» تَعْنِي خَمْسَةً وَثَلَاثِينَ. وَأَخِيرًا، أَرْفُضُ الإِجَابَةَ العَامَّةَ لِأَنَّهَا كَثِيرًا مَا تَكُونُ مُشَتِّتًا، وَأَخْتَارُ الإِجَابَةَ المُحَدَّدَةَ المَرْبُوطَةَ بِالنَّصِّ.

lessons.summary: Master the P1 error zones, revise the whole grammar spine, and prepare a fluent health topic conversation with spontaneous conditionals.
objectives: Correct the twelve most common P1 errors, especially prepositions and conditionals.
Retrieve the full P1 grammar spine accurately.
Use a Type 1 conditional and a medical passive in spontaneous speech.
Prepare five topic-conversation answers to assessment standard.
success: I use غَنِيٌّ بِـ, يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى and يُعَانِي مِنْ with the right preposition.
I keep إِذَا with a past-form verb and mark the result with سَـ.
I form the passive with an accurate vowel pattern.
I answer the conditional-required questions with a conditional, unprompted.

vocab.label: Nutrition prepositions — the P1 error zone

teach.title: Learn each verb with its preposition
teach.text: The most frequent P1 slips are prepositions: غَنِيٌّ بِـ (not مِنْ), يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى (not بِـ), يُعَانِي مِنْ (not بِـ). Store the preposition with the verb, as a single unit, so the correct one comes automatically in speech.

teach.title: Use the conditional without being asked
teach.text: In the topic conversation, Q3 and Q5 reward a Type 1 conditional. The mark comes from producing إِذَا … سَـ spontaneously: إِذَا نَظَّمْتُ وَقْتِي، سَأُقَلِّلُ الضَّغْطَ الدِّرَاسِيَّ. Rehearse it until it is automatic.

grammar.title: Repairing the P1 error zones
grammar.overview: Targeted error correction across the whole P1 spine: prepositions, conditional tense, passive vowelling and agreement.

rules.heading: Nutrition prepositions
rules.formula: غَنِيٌّ بِـ · يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى · يُعَانِي مِنْ
rules.explanation: Each collocation has one fixed preposition.

rules.heading: Conditional tense
rules.explanation: A past-form verb after إِذَا; the result marked with سَـ.

rules.heading: Recommended-with passive
rules.explanation: After يُوصَى use بِـ plus a verbal noun, not أَنْ plus a verb.

rules.heading: Passive vowelling
rules.explanation: ḍamma on the prefix, fatḥa before the ending; subject nominative.

quiz.prompt: Which fixes the preposition?
quiz.feedback: غَنِيٌّ is fixed with بِـ.

quiz.prompt: Which is accurate?
quiz.feedback: يَفْتَقِرُ is fixed with إِلَى.

quiz.prompt: Which is accurate?
quiz.feedback: يُعَانِي is fixed with مِنْ.

quiz.prompt: Which conditional is correct?
quiz.feedback: إِذَا takes a past-form verb; the result takes سَـ.

quiz.prompt: Which uses يُوصَى correctly?
quiz.feedback: يُوصَى takes بِـ plus a verbal noun.

quiz.prompt: Which passive is vowelled correctly?
quiz.feedback: ḍamma on the prefix, fatḥa before the ending, subject nominative.

quiz.prompt: Which agreement is correct?
quiz.feedback: A non-human plural takes a feminine singular adjective.

quiz.prompt: Which answers a conditional-required question well?
options: إِذَا غَيَّرْتُ عَادَةً وَاحِدَةً، سَأَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا.
quiz.feedback: It produces إِذَا … سَـ spontaneously.

grammar.common_error: Using مِنْ after غَنِيٌّ, بِـ after يَفْتَقِرُ, or بِـ after يُعَانِي. Store each verb with its own preposition.

listening.title: Listening: a mock topic conversation
listening.script: المُعَلِّمُ: مَا نِظَامُكَ الغِذَائِيُّ؟ الطَّالِبُ: طَعَامِي غَنِيٌّ بِالخُضَارِ وَالبُرُوتِينِ، لٰكِنَّهُ يَفْتَقِرُ أَحْيَانًا إِلَى الأَلْيَافِ. المُعَلِّمُ: كَيْفَ تَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ ضَغْطِ الدِّرَاسَةِ؟ الطَّالِبُ: أُعَانِي مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ قَبْلَ الامْتِحَانَاتِ، وَأَتَغَلَّبُ عَلَيْهِ بِالرِّيَاضَةِ وَالنَّوْمِ المُنَظَّمِ. المُعَلِّمُ: إِذَا كَانَ بِإِمْكَانِكَ تَغْيِيرُ عَادَةٍ صِحِّيَّةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، مَاذَا سَتَخْتَارُ؟ الطَّالِبُ: إِذَا اسْتَطَعْتُ تَغْيِيرَ عَادَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، سَأَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ، لِأَنَّ النَّوْمَ الجَيِّدَ يُقَوِّي التَّرْكِيزَ وَيُحَسِّنُ المِزَاجَ. المُعَلِّمُ: إِجَابَةٌ مُتَوَازِنَةٌ اسْتَعْمَلْتَ فِيهَا الشَّرْطَ تِلْقَائِيًّا.

reading.text: تَحْتَوِي هٰذِهِ القَائِمَةُ عَلَى أَخْطَاءٍ شَائِعَةٍ فِي السَّنَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ. الأَوَّلُ: «الطَّعَامُ غَنِيٌّ مِنَ البُرُوتِينِ» — وَالصَّوَابُ «غَنِيٌّ بِالبُرُوتِينِ». الثَّانِي: «الوَجْبَةُ تَفْتَقِرُ بِالأَلْيَافِ» — وَالصَّوَابُ «تَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى الأَلْيَافِ». الثَّالِثُ: «أُعَانِي التَّوَتُّرَ» — وَالصَّوَابُ «أُعَانِي مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ». الرَّابِعُ: «إِذَا تَتَمَرَّنُ، تَشْعُرُ بِتَحَسُّنٍ» — وَالصَّوَابُ «إِذَا تَمَرَّنْتَ، سَتَشْعُرُ». الخَامِسُ خَطَأٌ فِي التَّشْكِيلِ: «يُعَالِجُ المَرِيضُ» حَيْثُ يُقْصَدُ المَجْهُولُ — وَالصَّوَابُ «يُعَالَجُ المَرِيضُ». وَالدَّرْسُ المُشْتَرَكُ أَنَّ كُلَّ فِعْلٍ يُحْفَظُ مَعَ حَرْفِ جَرِّهِ، وَأَنَّ الشَّرْطَ يَبْدَأُ بِفِعْلٍ مَاضٍ وَيُخْتَمُ بِـ«سَـ».

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words preparing for the P1 topic conversation. Answer two of the assessment questions, using يُعَانِي مِنْ, يَتَغَلَّبُ عَلَى and at least two Type 1 conditionals, with every preposition correct.
checklist: Correct prepositions: غَنِيٌّ بِـ, يَفْتَقِرُ إِلَى, يُعَانِي مِنْ.
Two Type 1 conditionals, past verb after إِذَا and سَـ in the result.
One Form II benefit verb (يُقَوِّي or يُحَسِّنُ).
A balanced, spontaneous-sounding answer.
writing.model: نِظَامِي الغِذَائِيُّ غَنِيٌّ بِالخُضَارِ وَالبُرُوتِينِ، لٰكِنَّهُ يَفْتَقِرُ أَحْيَانًا إِلَى الأَلْيَافِ، وَأُوصِي بِتَنَاوُلِ الفَوَاكِهِ يَوْمِيًّا. أُعَانِي مِنَ التَّوَتُّرِ قَبْلَ الامْتِحَانَاتِ، وَأَتَغَلَّبُ عَلَيْهِ بِالرِّيَاضَةِ وَالنَّوْمِ المُنَظَّمِ. إِذَا نَظَّمْتُ وَقْتِي جَيِّدًا، سَأُقَلِّلُ الضَّغْطَ الدِّرَاسِيَّ وَسَأَشْعُرُ بِرَاحَةٍ أَكْبَرَ. وَإِذَا غَيَّرْتُ عَادَةً صِحِّيَّةً وَاحِدَةً، سَأَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ، لِأَنَّ النَّوْمَ الجَيِّدَ يُقَوِّي التَّرْكِيزَ وَيُحَسِّنُ المِزَاجَ. فِي رَأْيِي، التَّوَازُنُ بَيْنَ الغِذَاءِ وَالحَرَكَةِ وَالرَّاحَةِ هُوَ أَسَاسُ الصِّحَّةِ.
